jobs.title: Tax Operations Intern
jobs.description: We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.  Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.  This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.  The role  You work right in the middle of our tax work for doctors’ and dentists’ practices. You support our tax advisors on live mandates from day one. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you also help turn manual steps into automation.  Tasks     Ongoing bookkeeping.  Prepare financial accounting for our practices in DATEV: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation.     Year-end and returns.  Prepare annual financial statement packages and give draft-level input on tax returns, with feedback from our tax advisors.     Deadlines and documents.  Support our digital mail and tax-assessment processing, deadline control and client master data.     Client communication.  Run structured document requests and follow-ups with our practices.     Automation.  Test our internal tools and help automate recurring steps such as document classification and data extraction.    Requirements     Relevant studies.  You’re studying business, economics, law, tax or a related field, with a strong interest in tax and accounting.     First practical experience.  You’ve worked in a tax firm, accounting or audit, as an intern, working student or trained Steuerfachangestellte/r.     Care & accuracy.  You work carefully and precisely, because in tax every detail counts.     Structured & independent.  You organise yourself well and get things done without everything spelled out.     Tech-savvy.  You use AI tools comfortably and enjoy building small automations. DATEV experience is a plus.     German language skills.  Our clients speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and good English.    Benefits     Learn hands-on from tax advisors.  Work side by side with experienced tax advisors on real mandates, with direct feedback and mentoring.     Ownership from day one.  Take on real responsibility in live client work early on.     Front-row seat to AI in the real world.  See how AI changes the daily work of a tax firm and help build it.     Healthcare insight.  Understand how medical and dental practices work financially, a segment few tax firms truly know.     A path to stay.  Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time.    The details  Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.  How to apply  Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

jobs.title: Internship - Strategy & BizOps
jobs.description: about us    Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.   For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.   AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to interact with their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.   At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.   We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.   Check out our   principles   to see how we work.     mission   As the Strategy & BizOps Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. jobs.title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle  Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.  Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.  Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.  Deine Verantwortung  Zielsuche und Marktanalyse    Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.    Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.    Bewertung und Due Diligence    Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.    Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.    Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.    Verhandlung und Abschluss    Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.    Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.    Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.    Deine Perspektiven   Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:     Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.    Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.     Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:     Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.    Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.     Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:   Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.  Das bringst du mit  Erfahrung & Track Record    Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.    Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.    Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.    Skills & Arbeitsweise    Du bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint und baust Modelle, die ein Dritter verstehen und weiterrechnen kann.    Du liest einen Jahresabschluss so, dass du erkennst, was erklärungsbedürftig ist, statt Kennzahlen abzuschreiben.    Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Aufbereitung von Datenräumen und Drafting.    Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf einem Niveau, das für Verhandlungsunterlagen trägt.    Mindset & Persönlichkeit    Du behandelst Vertrauliches selbstverständlich vertraulich und interessierst dich für das Unternehmen hinter den Zahlen.    Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.    Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst     Keine zweite Reihe.  Deine Arbeit geht in eine Verhandlung, die diesen Monat stattfindet.     Keine Deal-Romantik.  Wir kaufen, um zu behalten. jobs.title: Credit Intern
jobs.description: About Wayflyer   Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.  Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.  You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.     The challenge   Wayflyer funds eCommerce businesses, and every funding decision comes down to understanding how those businesses really work and where they can go wrong. This role exists to help us get better at that. You'll learn the risks first-hand, working alongside the people who underwrite, sell and manage our customers.     What you'll actually do     Get to grips with the risks of running an eCommerce business, and of Wayflyer funding one    Help coordinate regular calls with customers, so we understand their business and funding needs    Support a team of Analysts who underwrite our customers    Work with our sales and operations teams to understand how they win and manage customer relationships    Learn our loan portfolio and portfolio management tools, including how to spot when it’s time to exit a risky relationship    Work with colleagues across the business (you won’t stay in one lane for long)       What this role could turn into    Interns here work on live deals, not side projects:    Owning a live process end to end, not just supporting it    Working real credit deals of up to $500K, with real responsibility for the outcome    A route into our graduate hiring pipeline, for the people who show what they can do       Who thrives here   You’re articulate, curious and a self-starter. You sweat the details, and you go after things without waiting to be asked. You’re passionate about FinTech and eCommerce, and you want to learn how underwriting, credit risk analysis and portfolio management work from the inside. You’ll probably end up doing things that aren’t in this job description. That’s not a warning - it’s the point.     We hire for range     You’re going into your final year of an undergraduate degree    Your major is Accounting, Finance, Economics, General Business or Statistics    You’ve shown interest in credit beyond the classroom, through an investment club, a student-managed endowment or anything similar    You’re comfortable relocating to Charlotte for the summer        Location and working policy    📍 Charlotte, North Carolina. This is a 2.5 month internship, and we would love to have you in the office 5 days a week because that’s where you’ll learn the most.     The good stuff   25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.     By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at    privacy@wayflyer.com    or review our privacy notice at    https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Founders Associate Intern - Strategy & Finance (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns  Bei  VREY  bauen wir das  EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .  In Deutschland stehen über  3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser  – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende.   Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.  Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.   VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software  und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).  Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:     Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,      ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter,  und     digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.     Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.  Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir  3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs  (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.  Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Energiewiertschaft oder Betriebswirtschaft oder befindest dich in deinem Gap-Year    Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg    Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit    Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten    Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst    Du bist in  Berlin  (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase    Du sprichst  Deutsch und Englisch fließend        Deine Aufgaben   Mission der Rolle    Du unterstützt unseren COO Cedric bei Finance-Themen, administrativen & strategischen Aufgaben sowie bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen seines Energy Operations Team.  Dein Ziel: Strategische und administrative High-Prio Projekte strukturiert voranbringen, interne Prozesse skalierbarer machen und Cedric datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Dabei wirst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Finance, Operations und Start-Up-Strategie entwickeln.   1. Unterstützung bei administrativen & operativen Weiterentwicklungen     Du unterstützt Cedric beim Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen, Standards und Templates für operative Projekte    Du unterstützt bei der operativen und technischen Umsetzung laufender Kundenprojekte - von der Unterschrift bis zur erfolgreichen Realisierung    Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Komplexität sowie Optimierungspotenziale     3. Prozessoptimierung & interne Strukturen     Du entwickelst interne Prozesse und Tools (z. B. in Airtable) weiter, um operative Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen    Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und setzt konkrete Optimierungen, z.B. mittels Automatisierungen, um    Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Special Projects in den Bereichen Finance, Tooling und interne Strukturen       Benefits   Vergütung:  Kompetitives Gehalt   Startdatum:  so bald wie möglich   Team & Benefits:  Lustiges Team, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket   Weitere Vorteile:  Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten   Das Wichtigste:  Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.     Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss   Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass  Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . jobs.title: Marketing / Business Development intern
jobs.description: Join Our Team as a Marketing/Business Development Inter at Beyond Sports      This a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across both marketing and business development, working to drive brand awareness and expand our market presence. In this role, you will assist in creating and executing marketing campaigns while helping to identify new business opportunities and contribute to projects for top-tier clients such as the NHL, ESPN and UEFA.     In addition to contributing to the daily operations of our Marketing and Business Development departments, you'll have the opportunity to work on your own internship project or graduation thesis. At Beyond Sports, we encourage you to maximize your internship experience and enhance both your professional and personal skills. You'll be guided by an experienced team lead, ensuring you get the most out of your time with us.      Your tasks and responsibilities    Marketing   · Support the team in brainstorming, creating, and executing campaigns for company initiatives, projects and promotions.  · Stay up to date with the latest marketing trends and proactively suggest ideas for content, campaigns, and PR activities.  · Assist in the creation of content for social media and blogs, including video shoots support.  · Assist in the planning and distributing of internal communications both within the company and the wider Sony group.  · Organize and manage Beyond Sports’ marketing assets.  · Monitor and report on PR activities related to key projects.  · Conduct research and competitor analysis to support strategic decision-making.      Business Development   · Conduct market research to identify potential markets, clients, industry trends  · Contribute to brainstorming sessions to create the best projects and experiences for new and existing clients  · Assist in crafting pitches, presentation decks for clients      Who are you?   · Passionate about sports, technology - or both!  · You are available 4-5 days a week in our office for at least 5/6 months.  · You would describe yourself as proactive, creative and a team player.  · Strong command of English, both in writing and speaking.  · Capable of working efficiently to meet deadlines.  · Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.  · Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel required).  · Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.  · We prefer that the intern is enrolled at a Dutch university or college for the entire duration of the internship and must provide us with an internship agreement.  · Bonus: Graphic design skills or experience with Figma, Canva or other design tools.      About Beyond Sports   Beyond Sports is an AI-based data analysis and visualisation company that offers a new way of experiencing sports. Our Emmy Award-winning visualisation platform enables real-time digital sports engagement solutions for leagues, broadcasters, brands and ultimately the end consumers. We deliver sports content spreading from traditional media all the way to the Metaverse. As part of Sony's sports businesses we aim to shake up the industry through data and entertainment.      Join us!   We’re excited to welcome enthusiastic and talented interns who are ready to make a difference in the future of sports technology. Join us at Beyond Sports, where you'll have the chance to contribute to innovative sports experiences and grow your skills in a supportive environment.

jobs.title: Quantitative Research Internship - Quant Research/Trading - starting Summer 2027
jobs.description: About Wincent   We are a team of over 150 people, primarily Engineers, Traders and Quants, focused on HFT with ~1% of global crypto trading volume. Being a bit weird, we    Are self-taught; our founders do not come from any of the big HFTs    Chose to have no VCs on cap-table; this spot is for our colleagues    Made Bratislava the central hub, not London or Amsterdam    Culture  When you do something you love, it does not feel like work. At Wincent work is purposeful and fulfilling.   Integrity is not negotiable   Handshakes are sacred for us. Being in the money making business is good, but that alone is not worth our soul; we follow the motto “Be the good guys in the market”.   Say things as they are   Life is too short for games of politics, fluff, or bullshit in general.   Trust each other   We embrace internal radical transparency in terms of compensation, bonuses, and trading strategies    A 7-week Quant Research/Trading Summer Internship with Relocation Provided  Would you like to be paired with experienced traders who will teach you how to identify market signals, analyze and execute trading strategies, conduct statistical analysis, construct quantitative models, and enhance your trading intuition?  If you answered "YES," we've got something special for you: Join us as a  Quantitative Research/Trading Intern   for 7 weeks  on-site in Bratislava, Slovakia. We support Schengen and UK citizens with accommodation & travel arrangements.  You'll dive into the exciting world of cryptocurrency trading, gain hands-on experience in quantitative analysis, algorithm development, and market research. As a Quant Intern, you'll have the opportunity to  contribute to real projects, learn from experienced quant traders,  and gain practical experience to get a head start on your trading career.  Working on projects alongside mentors will give you a sense of the variety of problems we solve every day. Throughout the summer, you'll also participate in simulated interactive mock trading sessions.  Apply today to join our  Quantitative Research/Trading team.     About the Quant Research/Trading team  Our trading team digs into fresh trading ideas and tweaks the ones we already have. Most of our trading is fully automated, but we're not afraid to mix in some gut feeling or out-of-the-box ideas if they seem promising. A solid trader usually rocks a mix of strong technical skills (think stats and basic coding) and a good feel for probabilities and expected values.  What will you do in the Quant Research/Trading team  We’ve structured the program to be both fun and challenging, with a typical day including:    Morning betting games to get the day started.    Discussions on trading-related topics to deepen your understanding of market dynamics.    Work on practical exercises that mirror actual quant and trading tasks.    Time to explore your own ideas and projects, supported by our experienced team.    Play various games to enhance your trading intuition. jobs.title: Strategy Intern
jobs.description: We are seeking curious, sharp and creative Strategy Interns to join the Strategy team at ZURU. There are opportunities across brand strategy for new and existing brands, as well as fast-turnaround work for ZURU Labs, depending on the strengths and interests of each candidate. This internship is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, working on global brands. As a Strategy Intern, you will support the strategy team with the research, analysis and ideation that sit behind our brand platforms, names and creative territories.   Who We Are   ZURU is a reimagination company. We look for categories that have stood still, then we build next-generation products and brands that set the new standard. ZURU Toys is reimagining play. ZURU Edge is reinventing everyday consumer brands. Rhodes Pet Science is reimagining pet science. ZURU Tech is leading the next building revolution.  ZURU started in 2003 with two brothers from New Zealand, and we're still founder-owned and operated today. Since then we've become the world's second-biggest privately held toy company, and nearly half of all Gen Y and Gen Z households with kids in the US own a ZURU product. Today we're 5,000 people in 34 offices, selling into more than 150 markets, backed by over 100 acres of fully automated manufacturing. And we're only getting started.    What you'll bring  • Current enrolment in, or recent graduation from, a tertiary programme in marketing, communications, business, design or similar  • A natural curiosity about brands, culture and consumer behaviour, and a keen eye for emerging trends  • Strong research skills, including the ability to find, sift and make sense of information from a range of sources  • Clear, sharp written communication  • Confidence building well-structured, visually clean presentations (PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides or Figma)  • Creativity and the ability to generate ideas, whether names, angles or ways of framing a problem  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and to follow instructions  • Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work  • Great attention to detail, file management and timeliness with tasks; ability to self-manage with strong problem-solving skills  • Interest in consumer categories such as toys, beauty, pet, haircare, fragrance and lifestyle is an added advantage    Roles & responsibilities  •  Research & Insight:  Assist the strategy team with category and competitive research across a range of projects, including:  – Competitive brand audits (naming, positioning, tone of voice and visual territory)  – Cultural and consumer trend tracking across social platforms, retail and marketplaces  – Retail and shelf checks to understand how categories are presented  – Other tasks management may deem appropriate from time to time  •  Synthesis:  Turn raw research into clear summaries and key takeaways the team can act on  •  Ideation:  Work closely with team members to brainstorm and develop ideas for names, positioning and creative territories  •  Naming Support:  Generate name options, apply first-pass filters for tone, distinctiveness and clearance risk, and help build shortlists  •  Presentation Building:  Take direction from strategy leads to build and format decks that communicate research and recommendations clearly. Maintain an eye for detail and high quality across all outputs  •  Collaboration:  Collaborate with creative & design, marketing, and copy & communications teams to understand project requirements and support delivery that aligns with brand objectives  •  File & Knowledge Management:  Organise and maintain research, decks and reference libraries so they're easy for the team to find and reuse  •  Feedback Incorporation:  Be open to feedback and make revisions as required to improve the quality of the work  •  Time Management:  Manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Understand briefs and turn them around efficiently, including quick-turn requests where timelines are tight  •  Research and Trends:  Stay up to date with cultural, category and industry trends, and apply that knowledge to project work   Please note applications for this internship close on November 30th. Applicants moving to the next stage will be contacted after this date.       Who thrives at ZURU   This isn't a 9-to-5. We move fast, think big and set goals most companies would call impossible, then go after them. The people who thrive here are entrepreneurs at heart. They own their work, chase bold ideas and never stop raising the bar.   At ZURU, you drive your career, and we give you the platform to take it as far as you can. There are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else, and you'll be surrounded by talented people who make things happen. We're a true meritocracy: we reward impact, not tenure.      How we work   Big ideas happen when great people work side by side, so we're office-first by design. Being together means faster collaboration, sharper decisions and stronger teams, and it's where the real learning happens. Some flexibility may be available depending on the role, location and business needs, but most roles are office-based.  Want to see what life at ZURU really looks like? Follow  LIFE@ZURU  on Instagram or  www.zuru.com      ZURU – Reimagining tomorrow 🚀   #LI-PK1   ZURU may use AI tools to help screen, assess or select applicants.

Opportunities within Finance include Financial Planning and Analysis, Accounting, Internal Audit, Treasury, Capital Projects, and Financial Reporting.       DIGITAL & TECHNOLOGY (Internship ONLY):  Generating and implementing new strategic or systematic approaches and creating dynamic technology solutions for our rapidly growing business. Committed to applying technology to solve business problems, our Analysts and Engineers partner with teams across the company, hone software development skills using cutting-edge tools, and create and uphold technology standards and processes.       SUPPLY CHAIN (Full-Time and Internship):  Supporting our global logistics network to efficiently deliver products for our brands. The A&F Full Time Leadership Development Programs offer competitive compensation packages for trainees. (A&F Co.) is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.       The company operates a family of brands, including Abercrombie brands and Hollister brands, each sharing a commitment to offer products of enduring quality and exceptional comfort that support global customers on their journey to being and becoming who they are. jobs.title: Finance Intern
jobs.description: Seniority Level: Internship         Become an intern   at AB InBev   in   the vibrant city of Prague!                  Purpose:   ​       Brewing the world’s most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. ​We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. ​ ​      ​    That’s Who We Are: Come and  OWN IT               Internship   Description            This internship is a      full-time, unpaid      opportunity in   our   Prague   Capability Hub  , with a chance for you to discover what   it's   like to work in one of the top 5 FMCG companies in the world.   You   will work on   real business   projects   and will   be in frequent contact with your line manager to align on your next steps and responsibilities  .          As an intern, you'll get the chance to experience the “real life” business whilst developing your skills - learning through experiencing different areas of the business and building your own reputation. With the right focus and attitude, the internship can lead to a long-lasting career with AB InBev. You will work in our  Finance  department and will be in frequent contact with your line manager to align on your next steps and responsibilities.       What will you be doing   ?       Take your first steps into the world of Finance within AB InBev! There are 4 different teams that you can join:       Our  Risk Management  team is responsible for assessing the credit risk of new and existing customers. As an intern, you will be monitoring the financial risk and payment behavior of both type of customers. On top, you will have the opportunity to participate in different projects, such as reporting, improving payment behavior data models and credit risk models. This experience will teach you how to work with analytical tools such as Power BI and Power Query.      The  Credit Management  team is in direct contact with our customers to continuously improve the cash flow of the company. You will play a crucial role to cooperate with Sales to ensure that customers have good payment behavior and sustainable volumes. This internship is an excellent opportunity to understand how a large multinational operates, because you will manage processes with a lot of stakeholders (Sales, CX, AR, Invoicing, Logistics etc.) and will receive a personal target to improve one of these processes. You will learn how to drive financial results while boosting volumes and customer satisfaction.      Our  Dispute Management  team owns the end-to-end process of disputes resolution and the deductions applied. As an intern, you will help delegate and follow-up on the requests impacting the process with all implicated stakeholders: Credit, Sales Finance, Trade Investment Cell, Key Account Managers, FP&A, Invoicing etc. You will ensure that all requests are treated within the pre-determined Service Level Agreement parameters and will continuously look for improvements & automation opportunities across the process to reduce the lead time on the dispute resolution.      Lastly, in our  Trade Investment Cell  team, you will focus on knock off invoices with corresponding accruals, validating outstanding accruals as well as reviewing and verifying contracts, ERP records & invoices to ensure compliance. You will also help us drive the standardization across various processes, customer groups and market segments to comply to the most efficient standard way of working.      Based on the availability at the point of application and your personal ambitions, we will further guide you towards a position in one of the above-mentioned teams.          Internship Duration              The duration of the internship can range     from 4 to 6 months     or more, depending on your availability.                   Learning Opportunities                   70%     of your learning will come from on-the-job learning.         As an intern  ,     you'll   get the chance to experience   the real  -life business whilst developing your skills - learning through experiencing different areas and building your own reputation.                  20%     of your learning will come from mentorship progra  m  s, coaching, collaboration with key stakeholders & plenty of opportunities for feedback.                  10%     of your learning will come from formal   trainings  , including workshops & online training courses.    We will provide you with continuous opportunities to elevate your skills with access to free training sessions facilitated by AB InBev.            Prague Experience          You will immerse yourself in a vibrant corporate environment with a global reach and emphasis on a positive workplace culture.     You will enjoy the Open Beer Bar twice a week and you will be partaking in corporate events that bring teams together and engage in enriching team-building activities.     You will experience a sense of community within the internship program, providing a supportive network for personal and professional development. You will engage with like-minded peers, exchange ideas, and benefit from the wealth of knowledge and experiences shared within our international AB InBev internship community. Approximately 60% of our workforce consists of expats.           Other     B  enefits for   I  nterns           Box of beer every month  .           1-month trial period of     MultiSport   Card    .           AB InBev internal trainings (Project Management, Effective Communication, Data Automation, Microsoft Excel, Data Analytics, etc.).        Exclusive discounts     on leading brands such as   Datart  , and HP Market.           Refer a friend - get a box of beer  .           Global Mobility with Erasmus  +     grant    –     meet   the   criteria   and   you might be able to   apply     for     the   Eras

jobs.title: Student Assistant – Security Operations

You will get practical insight into how a professional security function operates and help improve the systems, processes, and documentation that support everyday security. jobs.title: 2027 Defensive Cyber Operations Undergrad Intern
jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.       All roles require onsite presence a minimum of four days per week. Some roles may require five days onsite based on role responsibilities, business needs and manager discretion. Schedule flexibility may be available depending on the role and manager approval, including a 9/80 work schedule and compensatory time off (time off earned for hours worked beyond 40 per week) for eligible employees. 

 The Aerospace Corporation is hiring a Defensive Cyber Operations Undergrad Intern position for the Cyberspace Combat Department (CCD) in the Information Systems and Cyber Division (ISCD).  This position will be full-time, 100% onsite at our office in El Segundo, CA    Job Summary   ISCD staff members couple the latest in information system technologies, such as elastic compute clouds, containerization, microservices, real-time operating systems, and visualization frameworks, with expertise in cyber security, software architecture, software engineering, data science, Artificial Intelligence, process improvement, and software development to deliver responsive, resilient, high-performance software intensive systems to our Intelligence Community, DoD, and civilian customers.   Interns will join our growing team of cybersecurity engineers who design, implement, and deploy cyber solutions to defend our nation’s most valuable assets in space. We support a variety of customers including the Space Force’s Space Systems Command (SSC), the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), and other civil customers (e.g. NASA) in order to resolve unique challenges in protecting their ground networks and satellite systems from sophisticated adversaries.        What You’ll Be Doing     Research and develop on-board defensive capabilities to protect Space Vehicles    Build innovative prototype tools and techniques to improve the cybersecurity posture of mission systems using current technologies such as containerization, cloud, and AI    Conduct vulnerability research and reverse engineering on space related software    Proactively interact with customers by communicating project status, technical findings, and give technical demonstrations. With more than 150 professionals fully dedicated to this sector as part of a single and integrated business offering a full suite of independent Investment Banking services (M&A, Structured Finance & Asset-Backed Securities (“SFABS”), Credit Portfolio Advisory, and Equity Capital Markets) to clients across Europe, the Americas, and Asia Pacific. jobs.title: Intern, Commercial
jobs.description: Job Description     Role Overview     We are seeking analytical, and detail-oriented  Commercial Intern  to join our team for a  6-month (24-week)  internship program. This role offers a unique hybrid experience bridging commercial strategy, supply optimization, account management, partner onboarding, data analytics, and project coordination. As an intern, you will dive deep into supplier performance data, optimize reporting dashboards, execute key supply optimization initiatives, and build essential onboarding and account management frameworks that directly impact our business operations.    If you are eager to learn how a fast-paced commercial ecosystem operates and want to develop highly transferable skills in data-driven decision-making, supply management, and commercial execution, this internship is for you.       Key Responsibilities      1. Onboarding & Account Management        Partner Onboarding:  Build, refine, and execute structured onboarding flows, collateral, and documentation for new hotels and commercial suppliers to ensure seamless platform integration.       Account Management & Supplier Engagement:  Support key account managers in day-to-day partner communications, operational follow-ups, and the preparation of weekly supplier sync decks and performance reviews.       Process & Workflow Mapping:  Design clear, actionable flowcharts and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for internal commercial workflows (e.g., promo code creation, supplier onboarding, account health checks).         2. Supply Optimization & Commercial Strategy        Supply Availability & Performance:  Analyze supplier inventory, availability, rate competitiveness, and booking conversion across target markets.       Promo & Activity Optimization:  Conduct deep-dive comparisons of Standalone vs. "Snap" (promotional/package) activities to identify growth drivers and optimize promo allocations.       Growth Initiatives:  Assist commercial leads in identifying supply gaps, regional demand trends, and actionable opportunities for portfolio expansion.         3. Data Analytics & Dashboard Optimization        Audit Reporting Systems:  Review and assess existing commercial dashboards (Demand, Supply, Performance) and data structures to identify gaps in data quality and accessibility.       KPI Enhancement:  Collaborate directly with the Data Team to identify new business KPIs and develop proposals for dashboard enhancements.       Performance Deep-Dives:  Analyze geographical performance data and supplier performance trends to unlock actionable business insights.         4. Project Coordination & Stakeholder Communication        Track Milestones:  Apply project management fundamentals to actively track ongoing commercial, supply, and onboarding initiatives, ensuring timelines and key milestones are met.       Meeting Management:  Participate in cross-functional project meetings, document detailed minutes, and follow up with internal and external stakeholders on action items.       Progress Reporting & Summaries:  Keep internal teams aligned by preparing weekly and monthly commercial summaries and project progress updates.         Qualifications & Skills        Education:  Currently pursuing or a recent graduate with a degree in Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Project Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.       Analytical Mindset:  Comfortable working with data and metrics. Prior exposure to tools like Looker, dashboards, Excel/Google Sheets, or web/app analytics tools is a major plus.       Commercial Acumen:  Strong interest in e-commerce, account management, supply operations, and partner relationship building.       Communication:  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently interface with various stakeholders and document meetings clearly.       Organization:  Strong time management skills and an ability to handle multiple tasks, moving parts, and documentation simultaneously.       Problem Solver:  A proactive attitude with a keen eye for finding data inaccuracies, supply bottlenecks, or process inefficiencies.

jobs.title: Intern, Finance
jobs.description: Job Description       Job Summary:         We are looking for a diligent and motivated Finance Intern to support our finance team during the crucial year-end closing period. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in financial closing procedures, including reconciliations, audits, and financial reporting. The Finance Intern will assist in ensuring that all financial records are accurate and complete for the fiscal year-end.          Key Responsibilities:          Account Reconciliation: Assist in reconciling accounts, including bank statements, ledgers, and subsidiary accounts, to ensure all financial records are accurate.        Audit Preparation: Support the preparation of documents and schedules required for internal and external audits.        Journal Entries: Help in preparing and entering adjusting journal entries related to year-end closing.        Data Verification: Review and verify the accuracy of financial data, ensuring all transactions are recorded properly.        Financial Reporting: Assist in the preparation of year-end financial statements and reports, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.        Accruals and Provisions: Assist in calculating and recording accruals, provisions, and other year-end adjustments.        Compliance: Ensure all financial activities comply with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.        Documentation: Organize and maintain financial records and documentation related to the year-end closing process.        Ad Hoc Support: Provide additional support on various year-end tasks and projects as needed by the finance team.           Qualifications:         Education:         Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.          Skills:         Strong attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial data.        Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets and familiarity with accounting software.        Basic understanding of accounting principles and year-end closing processes.        Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks.        Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.        Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.          Experience:         Previous experience or coursework in accounting, finance, or audit support is beneficial but not required.           Learning Outcomes:          Gain practical experience in year-end closing procedures and financial reporting.        Develop a deeper understanding of accounting practices, reconciliations, and audit preparation.        Learn how to manage and verify financial data in a professional setting.        Enhance your ability to work collaboratively under deadlines in a finance team.

jobs.title: Intern, Finance (General Ledger)

This role provides hands-on exposure to full-cycle GL accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, and audit preparation in a fast-paced working environment.      Key Responsibilities:       1. General Ledger (GL) Operations      Assist in preparing and posting daily and month-end journal entries.    Maintain and update schedules for prepayments, accruals, and fixed assets.    Support the maintenance of the Chart of Accounts and ensure accurate transaction coding.       2. Month-End Closing & Reconciliations      Assist in month-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.    Perform monthly bank reconciliations and verify balance sheet account balances.    Support intercompany transactions and reconciliation of intercompany balances.       3. Financial Reporting & Documentation      Assist in preparing basic financial statements, trial balances, and management reports. Analytical, detail-oriented, responsible, and eager to learn.    Able to commit to an internship period (minimum 3–6 months preferred).

jobs.title: Intern, Finance (Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable)
jobs.description: Job Description    You will directly support the Finance & Accounting team in managing daily transactional accounting operations across both vendor disbursements and customer billings. This role provides comprehensive, hands-on exposure to both the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C) accounting cycles in a fast-paced corporate setting.     Key Responsibilities    1. Accounts Payable (AP) Operations     Invoice Processing: Receive, match, and verify supplier invoices against purchase orders (POs) and delivery receipts (3-way matching).    Claims Review: Check staff reimbursement claims and corporate credit card expenses against internal travel and expense (T&E) policies.    Payment Processing: Assist in preparing payment runs (bank transfers, remittances, corporate checks) and maintain updated payment tracking records.    Vendor Reconciliations: Reconcile monthly supplier statement of accounts against internal AP ledgers and resolve billing discrepancies or outstanding credits.      2. Accounts Receivable (AR) Operations     Billing & Invoicing: Assist in issuing customer tax invoices, debit/credit notes, and official receipts accurately and on schedule.    Receipt Matching & Allocation: Monitor daily bank inflows and allocate customer payments against corresponding outstanding sales invoices.    Customer Reconciliations: Generate and distribute monthly customer Statements of Account (SOA), following up on disputed billings and inquiries.    Credit Control & Aging: Assist with tracking AR aging schedules, identifying overdue accounts, and coordinating payment follow-ups.      3. Month-End Closing & Reconciliations     Assist with month-end closing activities for both AP and AR sub-ledgers.    Prepare schedules for accruals, unbilled receivables, and unallocated cash deposits.    Perform regular bank-to-ledger reconciliations for incoming receipts and outgoing disbursements.      4. Audit, Compliance & Digitalization     Maintain structured, audit-compliant digital archives for invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, and tax documents.    Assist in retrieving AP and AR sample documentation for statutory tax filings and internal/external audits.    Support ongoing finance automation initiatives, such as e-invoicing adoption and ERP workflow enhancements.      Requirements & Qualifications     Education: Currently pursuing a Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.    Accounting Knowledge: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, double-entry bookkeeping, and foundational P2P and O2C workflows.    Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel (basic formulas, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables); prior exposure to accounting software or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Xero, QuickBooks) is an advantage.    Attributes: High attention to detail, numerical precision, sound organizational skills, and clear communication.    Commitment: Available for a full-time internship for a minimum duration of 3 to 6 months.

jobs.description: The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.  This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.    The Data Support intern s primary role is to support the department’s systems and staff by recommending and implementing system enhancements that promote efficiency, compliance, and growth. The position requires a well-rounded individual that supports operations staff and systems by maintaining and monitoring production applications, processes, and data.  Regularly analyzing, maintaining, and supporting system files, tables, and configurations used to drive the base functionality of corporate applications.  Contributes to support activities and project assignments of low to medium risk and complexity.  This includes activities such as requirement definition, research, analysis, coordination, testing, training, and documentation.      PRODUCTION ANALYSIS AND SUPPORT:       Provides general support for various business applications, databases, and integrations.  Analyze systems, processes, and data issues of low to medium complexity and provide options to for remediation to more experienced team members.  Enter low to medium complex routine user-maintained table changes and configurations.  Troubleshoot low complexity system issues with limited direction.    Ability to identify priority issues and determine which issues can be handled within the authority of an analyst and being able to discern those issues requiring direction from a higher authority.  Contributes to training efforts by writing documentation and manuals, preparing presentations, delivering training, and providing follow-up.       DATA ANALYSIS:    Ability to extract data from a variety of internal and external data sources.  Support both scheduled and ad hoc report requests.  Analyze data to deliver reporting and metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.  Document new and existing data sources, processes, tables, and fields.  Validate the integrity of the data shown in reports by performing regular data analysis.       REQUIREMENTS DEFINITION:      Participate in analysis and definition of business and functional requirements, including client sessions and interviews.  Analyze requirements for new projects and processes.  Acts as the business and technical liaison during analysis, requirements definition, and design activities.       TESTING, DEBUGGING, TEST MANAGEMENT, QUALITY ASSURANCE:    Participates in definition of testing scope and scenarios, and estimates of effort, and duration on low to medium scale projects based on the business requirements.  Prepares test plans and scripts for low to medium scale projects.  Research, document, report, and communicate any defects with functionality, flow and/or program changes.    Performs user acceptance testing and deliver results for peer, team, and management review.       PROJECT MANAGEMENT:     Display knowledge of project management principles and apply Company approved methodology.  Prioritize and coordinate activities of project team members for low impact projects.  Participate as a project team member for low to medium complex projects.  Identify project issues and communicate progress and obstacles to sponsors and/or management.  Handles multiple tasks and small projects, concurrently.  Participate in cost/benefit analysis.     IMPLEMENTATION:     Coordinate production implementation efforts with User community and IT for low to medium complex support activities and project assignments.  Communicate implementation timelines and tasks.  Develop the User Documentation and Training material.  Train the trainers and/or impacted associates.  Post-implementation audits/reviews.       PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT, RELATIONSHIP BUILDING, AND COMMUNICATIONS:     Apply new knowledge rapidly. jobs.description: Healthy Careers Start Here     At  Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Mississippi  our Actuarial team is at the forefront of evaluating healthcare risk, predicting medical cost trends and ensuring the long-term financial sustainability of our patient care models. As an Actuarial intern, you will assist actuarial personnel in analyzing vast amounts of data to aid in the development and monitoring of rating formulas and factors, product monitoring and pricing, as well as claim reserving and trending.  This internship offers an exceptional opportunity to apply theoretical statistical modeling to real-world healthcare data which directly supports our pricing, reserving and strategic planning efforts. Extract and clean claims data for actuarial analysis.  Prepare exhibits and memos for senior leadership according to actuarial documentation standards.  Work alongside analysts and credentialed Actuaries on day-to-day operational activities.        Job-Specific Requirements:    Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in mathematics, actuarial science, statistics or related course of study where a strong mathematical background is necessary with at least a Junior level academic standing by the end of Spring 2027.  GPA of 3.25 or higher is required.  Possess strong PC skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.         Preferred Qualifications:    Enrolled in a Mississippi based College or University or Mississippi resident.         To be successful, you must:    Utilize problem-solving skills and transparently share insights.  Provide concise verbal communications, sharing ideas, information and communicating messages clearly, accurately and professionally.  Manage time effectively and handle multiple tasks in a dynamic environment.  Demonstrate strong organizational skills and attention to detail, checking work for errors before submitting.  Write concise messages, draft simple guides and communicate clearly in written form.  Listen closely during instructions, paying full attention to the speaker and ask clarifying questions before attempting to solve problems or provide feedback.         How to Apply and the Process:    Set up a Workday account and complete your application process.  Attach a copy of a resume and cover letter.  Check your email for updates.  Processes may include phone screen, testing, in-person interview (s), background and drug testing.       It’s good to be Blue! Founded as a private partnership in 1984, we have fostered a culture of innovation, entrepreneurialism, and agility, empowering our people to define and own their career trajectories. Today, our partnership approach enables us to pursue strategic growth, build enduring relationships with a robust external network, and collaborate across our integrated platform to connect the deep and diverse expertise that unlocks breakthrough insights.    Our people are the heart of our advantage.  Colleagues at all levels have a seat at the table as they tackle business challenges with a principal investor mindset. By asking incisive questions, respectfully challenging one another, and remaining intellectually agile, we work together to achieve exceptional outcomes.       Real Estate Overview    Since 2010, senior members of the Bain Capital Real Estate (“BCRE”) team have refined a thematic and nimble business model, focused on thesis-driven and resilient portfolio construction, designed to capture long-term demand growth and changing customer needs and preferences for real estate. Our team, which is led by Ryan Cotton, Partner, and comprises over 100 dedicated professionals, has been thoughtfully constructed to capture market opportunities at scale. To date, our strategy has been utilized for the acquisition of more than 730 assets with total equity commitments of $11.8 billion. This includes, but is not limited to, acquisitions across BCRE Fund I ($1.5 billion, 2018 vintage), BCRE Fund II ($3.0 billion, 2020 vintage), the BCRE Life Science Fund (~$800 million, 2021 vintage), and BCRE Fund III ($3.4 billion, 2023 vintage) value-add real estate funds focused predominantly on thematic investments in North America. We believe that while our business model is built to succeed in a broad range of environments, it is particularly well suited for the current period of volatility, with distress likely to create attractive deal flow over the near to medium term.     Averaging more than 20 years of applicable experience, Bain Capital Real Estate’s 11 Partners and Managing Directors have long and varied careers creating and managing innovative real estate and private equity investment platforms across an array of investment environments. Our senior team approaches decision-making with their expertise in acquisitions, asset management, portfolio management, financing, investment sales, investment banking, financial reporting, legal, engineering, and development management, in mind. They also have direct lines into long-time industry leaders as well as up-and-coming real estate players across a variety of asset classes and specialties. The team draws upon this foundation of complementary expertise and experience to source opportunities, drive value, and mitigate risk. As part of Bain Capital, the real estate team leverages the collective scale, experience, and network of the firm’s global platform to augment sourcing efforts as well as to deepen insights and understanding of underlying secular themes driving demand and changing customer needs and desires across sectors germane to its current portfolio as well as future investment themes.       Position Description    The Summer Analyst role is a 10-week Boston-based opportunity. Bain Capital professionals are exposed to a broad set of situations and companies and systematically develop skills as a value-added investor - not just a financial engineer. Summer Analysts will learn how to evaluate investment opportunities through the application of fundamental strategic analysis in addition to the more traditional financial modeling.     Ideal candidates will have a strong academic record. Candidates should exhibit the following skills and/or experiences:      Self-motivated, creative thinker with strong commercial instincts  Strong communication and interpersonal skills  Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills  Demonstrated ability to think creatively  Excellent academic record from a top undergraduate school             Compensation      Expected Weekly Base Salary: $2,100         This is the expected weekly base salary range for this position. Actual base salary will be determined by a wide range of factors including but not limited to role, function, level, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.         Bain Capital is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Student Assistant, Group Finance - Tax & VAT Compliance
jobs.description: Student Assistant, Group Finance – Tax & VAT Compliance     Are you a finance, accounting or tax student looking for hands-on experience in an international finance organization? And would you like to take real responsibility while developing your skills within VAT, tax compliance and financial reporting?    Then you may be the Student Assistant we are looking for to join our Group Finance team at Bavarian Nordic.   As our new Student Assistant, you will become part of Group Finance and work with a broad range of finance and tax compliance activities. You will be given responsibility for recurring VAT and tax reporting compliance tasks, while also supporting the team on other tax and finance matters.    Your responsibilities    Your main responsibilities will include:   Preparing VAT reporting, Intrastat and EU Sales Listings related to our European sales distributed from Germany.  Preparing VAT and Intrastat reporting related to movement of goods to and from our European Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).  Preparing various statutory reports to Statistics Denmark.  Supporting the collection and preparation of information for our transfer pricing documentation.  Assisting with input for our Country-by-Country Reporting and Pillar II reporting.  Performing weekly intercompany reconciliations, including investigating and following up on differences.  Providing ad hoc support during month-end close and the preparation of quarterly and annual financial reporting.         Your team    You will join a team of three colleagues consisting of two Financial Controllers and a Tax & Treasury Specialist, giving you the opportunity to work closely with experienced finance professionals.  You will also work closely with our Revenue Recognition team, giving you exposure to different areas of Group Finance and an understanding of how tax, accounting, revenue recognition and financial reporting interact in an international company.    Who are you?    We imagine that you:    Are currently studying finance, accounting, tax or a similar relevant field.    Have an interest in tax, VAT, accounting and financial reporting.    Are comfortable working  with numbers and have a structured and detail-oriented approach.  Take ownership of your tasks and ensure to deliver on time  Are curious, proactive and eager to learn and develop.    You are outgoing, enjoy interacting with others, and thrive in a collaborative environment where you work closely with colleagues across the organization.      Previous experience with VAT, tax or accounting is an advantage, but  not a requirement . More importantly, we are looking for someone who is motivated to learn and ready to take responsibility.    What do we offer?    You will become part of a dynamic Finance organization, where collaboration, a positive atmosphere and helping each other are important parts of how we work.   The role offers you an opportunity to gain practical experience in an international company and work with areas such as VAT compliance, transfer pricing, Pillar II, intercompany processes and financial reporting. You will have your own recurring responsibilities while having experienced colleagues around you when you need support.   We expect you to work approximately  15 hours per week , and we are flexible when it comes to which days you work, allowing you to balance the position with your studies.   Interested?    If you are ready to put your theoretical knowledge into practice and would like to gain hands-on Finance experience in an international environment, we would be happy to hear from you.

jobs.title: Workday Student Analyst
jobs.description: Job Description:        Berklee seeks a Workday Student Analyst to support Workday Student operations across our campuses and online. Reporting to the Senior Director, Workday Strategy and Operations, the Workday Student Analyst will work closely with the Workday functional and technical leads, while technically supporting the Registrar and Academic Affairs. This position will collaborate with business partners to identify, recommend, and implement system improvements and enhancements, including reporting, dashboards, and configuration changes that will enable Workday to support Berklee's strategic and operational priorities. The role will also function as a quality assurance and change management advocate to manage Workday’s bi-annual release cycles.       At Berklee, creativity, innovation, work-life balance, and mission-driven work guide our culture. Operating in a deeply student-centered environment, staff work collaboratively across teams to empower student success. Remote work is possible for this position.        Essential Duties and Responsibilities          Request Management & Troubleshooting:    Support intake tickets for Workday student-related requests; support enhancement requests, reporting requests, brakes/fixes; and troubleshoot system issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement permanent solutions.       Module Configuration & Workflows:    Maintain and configure Workday Student modules, including Admissions, Records, and Advising, and partner with the Workday platform team to enforce data quality standards and optimize workflows.       Testing & Change Control:    Test all changes and participate in change control; participate in Workday Student project testing and regression testing; build regression and acceptance test scenarios and coordinate continuous testing strategies with business process owners; and test integrations between Workday and external systems using Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB). Our expansion to the world's major destinations, along with our clear growth strategy, has allowed us to position ourselves as the 2nd largest chain in Spain and one of the top 30 in the world in terms of the number of rooms. Your Gateway to a Future in Hotel Management     Are you passionate about hospitality and ready to take the first step toward becoming a hotel manager? Under the direct mentorship of the Hotel Director and support of the Management Team, you’ll gain practical skills, strategic insights, and leadership exposure that will shape your career.     Why Join Us?     🌍  4–6 month internship  in one of our beautiful hotel destinations    🛏️  Shared accommodation  provided (subject to availability and destination)    🍽️  Full board included  throughout the internship    💶  Monthly financial support  during your stay    💼  Career progression opportunity : Upon completion, you may be selected to join our prestigious  Barceló Development Plan (PDB)  as an  Assistant to Management (ADH)  — a clear path toward becoming a  Hotel Manager          What are we looking for?        What Are We Looking For?   Motivated, committed, and curious individuals who want to grow within a leading international hospitality group. If you're eager to learn, thrive in dynamic environments, and aspire to lead, this is your moment.  Start your journey with Barceló — where your potential meets opportunity.    To be part of our  Barceló Hotel Management Internship Program , you should meet the following criteria:    🎓  Final-year student  in a Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Hotel Management (or a related field), and eligible to sign an internship agreement through your school or university    🏨  Previous hands-on experience  through at least two operational internships, ideally across different hotel departments (e.g., Rooms Division and Food & Beverage)    🌐  Strong English skills  (minimum B2 level); additional languages are a big plus    ✈️  Willingness to relocate  anywhere within the EMEA region — flexibility is key to your growth within the company.       Apply now and take the first step toward becoming a future Hotel Manager. En Barceló Hotel Group, te ofrecemos movilidad geográfica y la oportunidad de adquirir conocimientos sobre diversos productos y servicios a lo largo de tu carrera. * Entendemos que un equipo comprometido y experimentado es esencial para el crecimiento. Por eso tenemos planes de carrera específicos disponibles en diferentes áreas de la empresa, a los que tú puedes unirte. *Tendrás acceso a los mejores programas de capacitación del mercado, adaptados a tu posición dentro de la empresa. Además, porque creemos firmemente en el desarrollo personal, ofrecemos una amplia gama de actividades de formación abierta a través de nuestra plataforma de e-learning Barceló Campus.  * Te invitamos a explorar Barceló ReGen, nuestra estrategia de sostenibilidad. Esta iniciativa abarca numerosas acciones relacionadas con el desarrollo social, económico y medioambiental en todos los lugares donde nuestra empresa opera. ¡Queremos que te unas a nosotros en nuestro compromiso de construir un futuro mejor!  Como uno de nuestros mayores desafíos es asegurar tu felicidad, formar parte del equipo del Grupo de Hoteles de Barceló ofrece ventajas y beneficios adicionales, entre ellos:  1. Descuentos exclusivos en hoteles y viajes para ti, tu familia y amigos. 2. Acceso a una póliza de seguro de salud con numerosas ventajas y condiciones especiales para el grupo Barceló. 3. Descuentos con diversas empresas relacionadas con el ocio y el tiempo libre. 4. Ofertas especiales con empresas de productos y servicios. 5. Acuerdos exclusivos con diferentes escuelas de formación y negocios.             Contract type:  Intern (duración determinada)

jobs.title: Operations Internship
jobs.description: Join Bell Partners and be a difference maker.        At Bell Partners, our mission is to be the apartment company of choice by creating value and honoring commitments to our residents, partners, and associates. We proudly serve our community of 85,000+ homes across 13 states and the District of Columbia. As stewards entrusted to contribute with care and appreciation, our 2,000 associates succeed in a dynamic space where everyone impacts. We take pride in producing outstanding results and fostering a work environment that allows everyone to contribute to their fullest potential. We rise above industry standards when every associate embraces their unique role and seizes the opportunity to make an impact.                Bell Partners has big goals, just like you do. The only way we realize those aspirations and grow is to step out of our collective comfort zone, take risks, try new approached and learn from each other along the way. We hope you will do just that during your internship.     It’s pretty simple. We are highly focused specialist in a world with many competitors vying for our customers.  We rise above when every Bell Associate embraces their unique role and seizes the opportunity to make an impact and rally around our purpose of creating communities our residents are proud to call home.     Have fun, be part of a caring team all while you get hands-on learning experiences in a real business environment.  Our 10-week operations internship will rotate you through your assigned department.  We work with you to learn which track you are most excited about and put you right in the middle of all the action.      Your very first week you will have an opportunity to complete some fantastic personal development training, meet and network with departments and gain knowledge which will help you get the most out of your internship.  On your last week you will have an opportunity to create a presentation about your experience and share your thoughts and ideas to some of our Bell leaders.           Experience Overview:      We won’t let you get bored! You will be rotating throughout the program experiencing various roles within your assigned department(s).  During your exciting 10 weeks you will experience the following and more:     Assisting in preparing presentations    Special projects related to that business unit    Hands on experience with business processes    Working along with a project team and exposure to project meetings    Analyzing processes, reports and information and how it relates and impacts the business    Getting hands on experience with Bell’s internal platform systems and tools    An opportunity to work both independently and as part of a team      We want you to finish your internship feeling a sense of purpose, leave with a sense of accomplishment and hope you think of Bell as a future employer.       Compensation Range       Hourly: $20.00 - $20.00   Incentive compensation opportunities are available and are performance based.          About Bell Partners     Our purpose at Bell Partners is to create communities our residents are proud to call home. We currently own or manage over 85,000 homes in North America and continue to grow. Our people are the most important part of our company. We believe in building a culture that encourages our associates to invest in and serve one another, while pushing each other to take risks, allowing us to grow together and make a difference.       Join Bell to be a difference maker. Apply today!        Bell Partners reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.
