jobs.title: HR Intern - Talent & Leadership Development
jobs.description: Why this role  Curious about leadership, learning, and people development? Want to work on real projects, not just observe from the side?   We’re looking for  a Talent & Leadership Development Intern to support our Group Talent and Leadership team . This is a hands-on internship where you’ll learn how leadership development really works in a global organisation.    What you’ll do    Support global leadership and learning initiatives  Help create engaging learning content and communications  Contribute to talent and employee development projects  Assist with workshops, events, and leadership programmes  Work with colleagues from different countries and cultures  Analyse feedback and turn insights into action  Support strategic HR and transformation projects.   You’ll be involved from idea → execution → impact.    This role could be for you if you    Are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business or a related field at a university in the Netherlands (WO or HBO-level)  Are curious about leadership, learning, and growth  Like structure but also enjoy being creative  Feel comfortable working in English  Want to learn by doing    You don’t need to tick every box to apply.    What you’ll gain    Real experience in leadership & learning projects  Exposure to global teams and senior stakeholders  Continuous feedback and support  Skills you can actually use in your future career     What we offer    A full-time internship for 4 to 6 months, starting in January or February 2027  A competitive internship allowance of €500-550 per month (based on 40 hours per week)  A company laptop to support your work  The flexibility to work in a hybrid setup after a successful onboarding     How to apply  Apply through our Careers Page and send:   Your CV  A short motivation explaining what interests you about leadership and people development     Why BDR Thermea Group  At BDR Thermea Group, leadership is about impact, responsibility, and learning together.   We value:   Respect and inclusion  Collaboration across cultures and teams  Continuous learning and development  Empowerment and ownership    We aim to create a workplace where everyone can contribute, develop, and feel a sense of belonging.    About the company    At BDR Thermea Group, we bring the energy transition closer every day. Serving customers in more than 100 countries with a diverse team of 7,000, we are united by a shared mission to create a sustainable future through smart indoor climate solutions. We champion innovation, customer focus, and a cohesive team culture.    BDR Thermea Group is a proud equal opportunity employer, valuing diversity and inclusivity. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to join us in shaping a more sustainable, innovative future for everyone.        What’s it like to work at BDR Thermea Group?    At BDR Thermea Group, we don't just talk about making a difference - we live it every day. As a team member, you'll be part of a company leading the way in the global energy transition, shaping the future of sustainable heating and hot water systems.    Work alongside passionate colleagues who share our core values: One Team, Sustainable Future, and Customer Focus. We support your growth, development, and well-being in a purpose-driven environment that encourages creativity, innovation, and collaboration. Join us on our journey toward a sustainable future.     At BDR Thermea Group, we believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) are critical to our success. We are committed to creating a workplace where every potential future employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Please check out our DE&I policy on our website to find out more.

jobs.title: Compliance Intern
jobs.description: At Ayvens, progress starts with you.     Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.     Ayvens, Società del Gruppo Société Générale, è il nuovo brand globale della mobilità sostenibile, nato dall’unione di ALD Automotive e LeasePlan. L’azienda è uno dei leader globali nei servizi di noleggio a lungo termine e gestione flotte ed offre servizi di noleggio e soluzioni di mobilità integrata a clienti di ogni dimensione, dalle grandi alle piccole e medie aziende, dai professionisti ai privati e alla PA, verso una mobilità a zero emissioni attraverso innovazione e servizi tecnologici d’avanguardia. In Ayvens le Persone fanno la differenza, in un viaggio in cui siamo guidate/i da 4 principi fondamentali che caratterizzano la nostra Cultura: Collaboration, Commitment, Curiosity, Authenticity. Siamo alla ricerca di nuove risorse desiderose di inserirsi in un contesto multinazionale, strutturato, dinamico e inclusivo. Se sei appassionato/a del settore Automotive e desideri intraprendere un'esperienza di Stage dall'alto valore formative, Ayvens sta cercando proprio te!Scopo della posizione:         Scopo della posizione:      Collabora con il proprio tutor al fine di garantire che l’azienda operi in linea con le politiche aziendali e di Gruppo e nel rispetto della normativa vigente al fine di tutelare la società e il Gruppo da rischi di natura reputazionale.         Principali attività:           Supportare la squadra nelle attività quotidiane di Due Diligence;      Supporto nell’analisi di file con diverso rischio reputazionale di clienti, partner, fornitori in base a quanto prescritto dalle procedure interne e di Gruppo;      Supportare il team nella conduzione di attività di risk assessment e reporting; jobs.description:

Experience with, or an interest in learning, tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint. jobs.title: 2027 MBA Internship Program - Investments - Direct Private Opportunities - Portfolio Management - New York
jobs.description: About this role        What is Direct Privates Opportunities ("DPO")?     BlackRock’s Direct Private Opportunities (“DPO”) team is an opportunistic investment platform with over $3 billion in assets under management. The team invests directly across private markets, providing flexible debt and equity capital solutions to companies and asset owners across industries and geographies. DPO seeks to capitalize on complex, idiosyncratic, and misunderstood risk/reward opportunities to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns with differentiated exposures that are complementary to traditional public and private market investments. DPO employs a highly flexible investment mandate, combining rigorous fundamental underwriting with creative structuring to identify opportunities that may fall outside traditional private equity and credit strategies.    MBA Internship Program    Our nine-week MBA Internship, from June to August, puts you at the heart of BlackRock. You’ll work with a team, gain exposure across our businesses and connect with leaders who invest in your growth.   Eligibility:  MBA students graduating between September 2027 and July 2028 with at least two years of relevant pre-MBA work experience    What will you do as a Summer Associate?      The Direct Private Opportunities (DPO) team is seeking an MBA Summer Associate to support the evaluation, structuring, and execution of investments across a broad range of industries and transaction structures. The role requires strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a creative approach to investing. Key responsibilities include:      Support all stages of the investment process, including sourcing, evaluation, underwriting, structuring, execution, and ongoing portfolio monitoring    Evaluate investment opportunities through financial modeling, and scenario and sensitivity analyses    Conduct investment due diligence, including company and industry research, financial performance, and key investment risks    Support transaction execution, coordinating with internal teams, external advisors, and counterparties    Prepare investment committee memoranda, presentations, and supporting analyses    Analyze bespoke investment structures, assessing downside protection and risk-adjusted returns    Assist in reviewing and negotiating transaction terms and documentation alongside senior investment professionals      What capabilities are we looking for?      Excellent academic record required  2–5 years of relevant professional experience in private equity, opportunistic credit, investment banking, or similar fields; prior principal investing experience preferred  Strong quantitative, financial modeling, analytical and problem-solving skills  Strong intellectual curiosity and passion for investing, with an interest in structured and hybrid capital investments   Flexible and creative mindset, with the ability to evaluate opportunities across different industries and assess the risk-return trade-offs of various investment structures  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly to internal and external stakeholders at all levels of seniority  Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across investment teams and other internal and external stakeholders  Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a rigorous, fast-paced, and team-oriented environment      For San Francisco, CA and New York, NY only: The salary ranges for these positions are below. Please note, salary rates for a role are determined by department or team within a Business Area, as well as location of the role. jobs.description: Why Join Bracco Medical Technologies?      We care as much about our employees as we do our patients. Our culture fosters a work environment where employees can thrive, be passionate and have fun along the way.  Each member of the Bracco Medical Technologies team has the power to make a         difference......every         day!      Company Overview   Bracco Medical Technologies (BMT) is a global leader in contrast management solutions for angiography and interventional cardiology, providing injector systems, consumables, and connected software that help clinicians deliver safer, more efficient cardiovascular care. As our core angiography business matures, BMT is investing in a systematic push into adjacent clinical and commercial markets where our platform technology, brand equity, and customer relationships create a natural right to win.    Role Summary   The Marketing & Strategy Intern will be embedded within the Cardiovascular Platform marketing and strategy team, supporting two priority workstreams: evaluating adjacent market opportunities and advancing voice-of-customer research that informs product and commercial strategy. This is a high-visibility opportunity for a student who wants hands-on exposure to strategic marketing, market sizing, and customer insight work within a global medical technology company, with meaningful opportunity to apply AI tools to real business problems.    Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities    Support Cardiovascular Adjacency Research    Complete opportunity and business cases for key adjacent markets, including market sizing, competitive landscape assessment, and evaluation of unmet clinical needs  Conduct primary and secondary research (industry reports, clinical literature, competitor intelligence) to validate assumptions underlying adjacency opportunities  Provide preliminary recommendations on BMT strategy and tactics for growing in these markets, including go-to-market considerations, pricing, and positioning  Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Marketing, R&D, Sales, and Regulatory) to stress-test opportunity assessments and ensure recommendations are grounded in commercial and technical feasibility  Leverage AI tools to develop and maintain a project dashboard that tracks adjacency initiatives, key milestones, and decision points for leadership visibility  Synthesize research findings into clear, executive-ready presentations and supporting business case materials         Support Voice-of-Customer Research    Support design of ongoing market research projects (qualitative and quantitative customer studies), including survey design, discussion guide development, and respondent screening criteria  Assist in project management of VoC projects to ensure internal deadlines are met, coordinating with external research vendors and internal stakeholders as needed  Help analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify key themes, customer pain points, and opportunities for product or service improvement  Leverage AI tools to support internal, cross-functional dissemination of key findings, including summarization, synthesis, and development of insight repositories  Support the translation of customer insights into actionable recommendations for marketing, product development, and commercial teams     Required Qualifications & Experience    Currently pursuing Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Marketing, Business, or related field required; rising junior or senior preferred  Experience with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) for research, analysis, or content synthesis  Experience in data analysis/analytics, including working with Excel, PowerPoint, and/or data visualization tools  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise recommendations  Demonstrated interest in healthcare, medical technology, or the life sciences industry a plus       Leadership Capabilities    Creative Problem-Solving   Demonstrated ability to think critically about business challenges, identify data and inputs needed to inform decisions, assess obstacles from multiple angles, and provide clear business recommendations.        Cross-Functional Influence   Exceptional ability to build alignment and drive results across matrixed teams without relying solely on organizational authority, by building trust, communicating clearly, and understanding the priorities of different functional partners across Marketing, R&D, Sales, and Regulatory.        Resilience & Agility   Ability to navigate ambiguity, lead through change, manage competing priorities, and maintain focus on strategic outcomes in dynamic environments, while remaining open to feedback and iterating quickly as priorities shift.      Location    Internship will be onsite in the Eden Prairie office       Duration & Hours    Full-time (40 hours/week) during summer 2027       Compensation & jobs.title: Corporate Development Internship
jobs.description: Contract type:  Internship   Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.     The Corporate Development office, through both Mergers & Acquisitions and Business Development teams, plays a key role in shaping Group’s long-term Strategy (Strategic Planning), identifying growth opportunities, supporting the execution of transactions (including acquisitions, licensing agreements, divestitures, equity investments and strategic partnerships) to strengthen  Group's long-term competitive positioning, and coordinating Global Business Units in defining their Strategic evolution pathway  Position Summary: We are looking for a highly motivated Intern to join our Mergers & Acquisitions and Business Development team. The intern will support the evaluation of strategic business opportunities, market and competitive analyses, financial assessments, and transaction execution activities across Bracco's business areas. In addition, the intern will support the shaping of Bracco’s business strategy and execution, by taking part into the Long-term Planning process, and supporting Global Business Units in the roll-out of key strategic initiatives. This internship offers exposure to strategic decision-making, corporate finance, licensing, acquisitions, and partnerships within the healthcare and life sciences sectors.    Key Responsibilities:     Supporting the assessment of external growth opportunities, including acquisitions, licensing, partnerships, and strategic collaborations;    Analysing company financials, business models, and strategic positioning;    Assisting in financial valuation activities, including comparable company analyses, precedent transactions, and discounted cash flow models;    Preparing investment memoranda, presentations, and briefing materials for senior management;    Conducting market research, competitive intelligence, and industry analyses across the pharmaceutical, diagnostic imaging, medical device, and digital health sectors;    Supporting Business Units/ Finance teams in the assessment of Business Cases;    Helping shape Bracco’s Long-Term strategy, coordinating Global Business units along the Strategic Planning annual process;    Working, alongside the Finance department, to assess the Plan robustness and consistency with Corporate strategic pillars;    Ensuring key projects are well executed in terms of timeline and key milestones;    Supporting due diligence activities by coordinating information requests and reviewing commercial, financial, and strategic documentation;    Monitoring industry trends, scientific innovation, and emerging technologies relevant to Bracco's strategic priorities;    Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Commercial, Finance and Legal.        Qualifications:     Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline, or currently pursuing a degree in one of these fields;    Strong academic record;    Previous internship experience in consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, venture capital, private equity, strategy, or healthcare is considered a plus;    Solid analytical and quantitative skills;    Basic understanding of corporate finance and valuation methodologies;    Previous experience in PMO activities is highly appreciated;    Familiarity with financial databases and tools (e.g., PitchBook, Capital IQ, Evaluate, IQVIA, Oracle Hyperion, Smartsheet) is considered a plus;    Fluency in English is required; Italian is preferred.        Personal Skills:     Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities;    Intellectual curiosity and interest in innovation within healthcare;    Excellent communication and presentation skills;    Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment;    Attention to detail and high level of accuracy;    Team player with a proactive attitude and willingness to learn.         What We Offer:     Hands-on experience in Corporate M&A and Business Development within a global healthcare company;    Exposure to strategic transactions and executive-level decision-making;    Mentorship from professionals with years of experience in Transactions and Strategic Planning;    Opportunity to work on international projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment;    Professional development in corporate strategy, financial analysis, and healthcare innovation;    Internship allowance, company canteen, and hybrid working arrangements.       If you meet the requirements of this opportunity and would like to join an international group working to improve patients' lives, apply now!    At Bracco, we believe in the values of diversity and inclusion. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people and their experiences, ensuring a fair opportunity for all.      We are #Bracco #JoinUs

jobs.description: Application Deadline:         12/03/2026     Address: 320 S Canal Street     Job Family Group: Commercial Sales & Service         Take your first step toward a career where insight, collaboration, and execution come together.   The U.S. COO Summer Internship Program is a 10-week experience designed for rising college seniors interested in strategy, analytics, transformation, business operations, governance, and enterprise execution. Interns will be aligned to a participating area within the U.S. Chief Operating Officer organization and contribute to meaningful business priorities while building foundational knowledge of BMO and the financial services industry. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Agency Analytics - Birmingham
jobs.description: Summer 2027 Internship- Agency Analytics - Management Team- Birmingham, AL        Company Overview    BWE is one of the fastest growing, privately held mortgage banking firms in the country. With over 500 employees in 33 offices, BWE has a national reach. We have a mission partner in Enterprise Community Partners, Inc, the nation’s largest non-profit corporation focused on affordable housing. Since 2012, BWE has contributed over $100 million to support Enterprise’s mission to advocate for, create and develop affordable communities that provide stability and a greater quality of life. We also have a capital partner in Fifth Third Bank, who owns a non-controlling interest in BWE. Fifth Third provides a strong balance sheet and expands our wide array of lending products to include bridge and construction loans.     BWE Agency Analytics Internship    BWE provides capital to owners of all types of commercial real estate. Our primary sources of capital in the multifamily sector are Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. In 2025, BWE will originate over $4 billion of debt that will be sold to these firms. Our Agency Analytics team supports these efforts by working with our producers nationwide, analyzing new investment opportunities, structuring capital options, presenting transactions to Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, and negotiating financing terms. The summer internship is designed to introduce students to the multifamily industry and explore how capital drives investment in communities.     Internship Goals - (What you can expect!)      Fundamental analysis of a multifamily transaction, including how we analyze property income and expenses, ultimately leading to a valuation.  Gain an understanding of the roles played by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac in the multifamily sector.  Learn about the various property types financed by Fannie/Freddie: - Conventional - Affordable housing - Manufactured housing communities - Seniors housing - Student housing  Learn the basics of our Excel loan sizing model. Be able to input financial statements and rent roll data.  Tour local properties of varying classes and vintages.  Support the analyst team in creation of transaction summaries.  Participate in deal clearance calls, Agency Analytics team calls and weekly production calls  Participate in the Future Housing Leaders summer program (as available)  Complete the Mortgage Bankers Association classes.  Participate in the Virtual Intern Networking Sessions  Participate in the Internal Speaker Series  Prepare an investment summary as a capstone project          We encourage you to explore the career opportunities we have available here at BWE!  Please note, BWE will not sponsor applicants for this position for immigration benefits, including but not limited to assisting with obtaining work permission for F-1 students, H-1B professionals, O-1 workers, TN workers, E-3 workers, among other immigration statuses. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

jobs.description: Please email               HR_Talent_AcquisitionTeam@bcbsri.org               if you are a candidate seeking a reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process.          At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.    We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.    We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.   It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.    Our culture is one of belonging.  We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.     Join others who value a workplace for all.  We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Summer 2027 Internship | Data Analyst, AI & Machine Learning Focus      School Year: Graduate Students  Dates of the Internship: June7th-August 13th (10 weeks)  Format: Hybrid in Lincolnshire, Illinois or Chicago, IL (Employees work in the office Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, with the option to work from home on Thursday and Friday).            About the role:  Camping World is looking for a Data Analyst intern for the summer of 2027 to work closely with the Data Management Office (DMO) and Data Science teams. We are looking for a driven individual who has foundational experience in data analysis but possesses a strong curiosity and capability to lean into artificial intelligence as a career. You will assist with daily operations and also be immersed in forward-looking AI projects. If you are eager to learn, have a strong interest in the future of data, and want to develop yourself as a professional at the intersection of analytics and AI, this is the ideal role for you.             What You’ll Do:       Use various programming software to organize, validate, and analyze large, complex sets of data to meet business requirements.       Partner with the DMO team for core tasks including data validation (comparing and verifying report metrics), data engineering (small tasks requiring SQL and Python), and data analysis (proving or disproving hypotheses using data analytics and visualization).       Partner with CW Data Scientists on advanced projects, including data forecasting, anomaly detection, and the implementation of machine learning models.       Build analytical tools and dashboards (Power BI) to provide actionable insight into key business performance metrics.       Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, optimizing data delivery, and automating manual processes.       Handle data requests from business stakeholders, assist with data-related technical issues, and effectively communicate insights through data visualization.       Explore new datasets and conduct experiments to validate hypotheses and make data-driven decisions, with a focus on identifying opportunities for AI application.       Take on individual special projects as needed to enhance your knowledge in machine learning, big data technologies, and AI implementation.              What You’ll Need to have for the Role:      Technical Skills      Data Manipulation & Wrangling: Skilled in working with data in various formats (CSV, JSON, SQL databases). Ability to clean, preprocess, and transform data. Proficient in writing SQL.       Programming: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data.       Data Visualization: Minimum 1 year of development experience with Microsoft Power BI or similar tools to communicate insights effectively.       Statistical Analysis: A strong foundation in statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and probability theory.       Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning algorithms. Understand the basics of supervised and unsupervised learning, feature selection, and model evaluation.       Cloud & Big Data: Exposure to a major Cloud Platform (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and a basic knowledge of big data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, or Hive is beneficial.       Mathematics: A solid understanding of linear algebra and calculus.             Other Skills      Anticipates problems, resistance or likely objections and takes action to resolve them.       Executes duties in a timely, efficient manner.       Ability to share information and knowledge, offering support and cooperation.       Interacts well on teams and can also work independently.             Education:      In pursuit of or a recent graduate with a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a closely related field.       A cumulative 3.0 GPA.       A graduation date between December 2026 - July 2028.       Ability to work in our Chicago or Lincolnshire office for the summer term. Camping World does not provide relocation or housing stipends.       Participate in Capstone Internship Project including a final presentation to Executive Leadership       Sufficient knowledge of Microsoft Office: Suite: (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)        Experience with software and web development         Excellent troubleshooting, data interpreting, and technical skills        Knowledge in Information technology (databases, system security, trouble shooting, etc.)         Ability to maintain professional demeanor and strict confidentiality         Must be diligent, organized, and extremely detail-oriented        Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment         Analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills and passion for data analytics        Strong written and verbal communication skills        Strong work ethic with research and note-taking skills         Ability to work in fast-paced environment with ability to multitask

jobs.title: BI & AI Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
BI & AI Analyst Intern      Chicago, IL (Hybrid) | 2027 Internship | Summer 2027 | 40hrs/week     Reports to: Manager, BI & AI Solution             About the Role      Camping World and Good Sam are rolling out AI across the company. That includes the AI tools used across the business and the AI agents our team builds and supports. We want to know who is using them, how often, what they use them for, and whether they are helping the business. As a 2027 BI & AI Analyst Intern, you will help build the reporting that answers those questions. The role combines BI, data, and AI work. You will pull and prepare usage data in Snowflake, build Data Analytics dashboards on AI adoption and agent performance, and share what you find with stakeholders and leadership.       What You'll Do       Data Analytics dashboards that track use of AI tools and agents by department and location       A set of adoption metrics such as active users, usage frequency, top use cases, and retention over time, each with a documented definition       Agent performance reporting on measures like accuracy, resolution rate, escalation rate, and cost to serve, built with the teams that run those agents       Simple value and ROI estimates for AI initiatives, such as time saved or cost avoided       A final readout on AI adoption across the company that you will present to the team and to leadership       Key Responsibilities       Write and troubleshoot SQL in Snowflake to pull, clean, and validate AI usage and agent data       Work with our AI engineers to understand what usage and log data each tool or agent produces and where it is stored       Help define adoption and usage KPIs and document how each one is calculated       Build and maintain Data Analytics dashboards, and review drafts with business users to get their feedback       Look for adoption trends, such as which teams use AI tools, which teams do not, and where usage drops off, and share what you find       Support ROI and business value analysis for AI tools and agents with help from senior team members       Write short summaries and presentations of your analysis for business stakeholders       Find and document data quality issues and escalate them when needed       Use approved AI tools for your own analysis, documentation, and SQL       What You'll Learn       How to measure AI adoption and agent performance at a large company       How to work with enterprise data in Snowflake and build actionable reports that people use       How to write KPI definitions that every team reads the same way       How to build a simple ROI case and explain the assumptions behind it       How to present findings to stakeholders and leadership in a short, clear format        What You'll Need to Have for the Role:       Required       Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field       Working knowledge of SQL from coursework, projects, or prior internships       Basic familiarity with a BI tool or willingness to learn quickly       Comfortable using data and spreadsheets to answer business questions       Good written and verbal communication, including explaining numbers to people who don't work with data every day       Careful with details and checks work before sharing it       Interest in AI tools and how companies adopt them       Preferred       Exposure to Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse       Experience using AI assistants for school or work       Coursework or projects involving KPI design, product analytics, or user adoption metrics       Familiarity with Python for data analysis       Basic understanding of how AI agents or chatbots work and how their quality is measured       A portfolio of dashboards or analysis projects        Education & Experience      Undergraduate or graduate student in Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field, or a recent graduate. Class projects, case competitions, and prior internships all count. We will consider a strong portfolio of dashboards or analysis regardless of major. No professional experience required.       How You'll Work      You will work within BI & AI Solutions with the AI engineers who build our agents, the data teams who own the underlying data, and the business users who rely on AI tools in their daily work. Your projects will be scoped at the start with clear goals, and the team will meet with you regularly to review your dashboards and findings. You will own your analysis and be expected to move it forward, and you can ask for help at any time. jobs.title: Song Service - Advisory intern February 2027
jobs.description: Internship Details      Period:  4 – 6 months      Hours per week:  32 - 40      Location:  Hybrid (ITO office, Amsterdam and work from home)      Start date:  February 2027      THE WORK    Hi future changemaker in Consulting!   Are you passionate about improving customer service and helping organizations rethink how they support their customers? As a Thesis Intern in the Service team at Accenture Song, you’ll explore how organizations can design and improve their customer service operations, processes, and ways of working.    In this role, you will combine research and hands-on consulting experience. You will learn on the job by supporting client engagements, working alongside experienced consultants, and contributing to real transformation projects – while also writing your thesis on a topic that creates real impact.     Team  The Service Group focuses on the Customer Experience & Service Reinventions domain - the front line of how companies connect with their customers.   Our consultants combine strategy, design, and technology to help global organizations deliver seamless, personalized, and intelligent service experiences.   We are especially exploring how AI can revolutionize customer interactions, streamline service operations, and unlock new business models.     YOUR ROLE    As a thesis intern, your role will consist of two main focus areas:    Research (Thesis)    You will define and write your thesis within the customer service domain, combining academic research with practical insights from our projects.    Consulting Support    You will support consultants in their daily work, gaining exposure to real client challenges and transformation projects.       Daily tasks  Your daily tasks may include:    Conducting research on customer service, digital transformation, and AI in service     Exploring how AI can enhance customer service, for example:     Supporting service agents     Improving customer interactions     Enabling more efficient service processes     Presenting your findings to internal teams and, where relevant, clients     Assisting in discovery phases, including fit-gap analyses of current service setups     Supporting the preparation of workshops, presentations, and client deliverables     Contributing to internal knowledge development and thought leadership     Supporting business analysis activities, such as structuring problems and identifying improvement opportunities     Mapping customer service processes and customer journeys         Research  You are free to define your own thesis topic within the service domain. Example directions include:    AI in Customer Service: How can organizations use AI to improve customer interactions?     Service Transformation: How can companies redesign their service operations for the future?     Customer Experience Innovation: From reactive support to proactive, personalized service     AI Adoption in Service: How willing are organizations to adopt AI in customer service?     Future of Service Models: From traditional contact centers to AI-supported ecosystems    We encourage you to bring your own ideas. Your research will ideally connect academic insights with real-world application. You can also bring thesis ideas related to the intersection of AI, digital experience, and service design - several previous interns have already completed theses in collaboration with clients and Accenture Consultants.          WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU     We expect the following qualifications and qualifications from an intern thesis:      Enrolled in a Master’s program at a Dutch university       Proactive and hands-on attitude       Strong analytical and structured thinking skills       Interest in consulting and advisory work       Affinity with customer service (basic understanding of CRM/CCaaS is a plus)       Interest in AI and its impact on customer service       Independent working style with a curious and entrepreneurial mindset       WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM US     As a thesis intern, in addition to the opportunity to gain hand-on consultancy experience within Accenture Song, we would like to offer the following:    Monthly internship compensation and laptop.     A personal  buddy  within the organization.     Access to Accenture’s  global network of experts and AI resources .     Hands-on consulting experience within  Accenture Song .     Participation in the   Song Talent Factory   – an intern program that connects you with peers across Song’s domains (Commerce, Design & Digital Product Creation, Marketing, and Customer Service).     Song Talent Factory (STF)  As part of this program, you’ll:    Receive professional guidance to shape your career path.     Collaborate on a real consulting project with other interns.     Attend skill-building workshops and networking events.     Join a vibrant intern community with social and learning activities.     From building an app for coffee catch-ups to dinners after work, the Song Talent Factory will make your experience at Accenture Song even more enjoyable!    . jobs.description: Chceš nastartovat kariéru v IT a získat zkušenosti na reálných projektech? Co bys měl/a mít   · Studium IT, technického, ekonomického, managementu nebo příbuzného oboru.  · Aktivní přístup, chuť učit se a schopnost spolupracovat v týmu.  · Dobrou znalost češtiny nebo slovenštiny a angličtiny slovem i písmem.  · Zájem o technologie, software, projektové řízení nebo business analýzu.  · Výhodou jsou zkušenosti ze školních projektů, stáží, hackathonů nebo studentských aktivit.     Co nabízíme   ·  Placenou studentskou stáž v Praze  ve stabilní mezinárodní firmě.  ·  Úvazek 20 hodin týdně,  vhodný ke kombinaci se studiem.  · Zapojení do reálných projektů s dopadem na klienty.  · Kontakt s různými technologiemi podle typu projektu — od vývoje aplikací na míru, například v technologiích jako  Java  nebo  React , přes podniková řešení jako  SAP  nebo  Salesforce , až po  cloudové služby  a  AI nástroje .  · Možnost učit se od zkušených konzultantů, analytiků a IT odborníků.  · Přátelské prostředí v mezinárodním týmu.  · Možnost dlouhodobé spolupráce a navázání juniorní rolí po škole. jobs.title: Finance Transformation - Working Internship
jobs.description: Stage details              Periode: 4 – 6 maanden                Uren per week: 40                Locatie: ITO kantoor, Amsterdam, thuis (flexibel)                Start datum: In overleg, 1st van de maand.                Geïnteresseerd?        Solliciteer alsjeblieft met je  CV, motivatiebrief en cijferlijst.  Geef aan in je motivatiebrief in welk team je het meest geïnteresseerd bent. Sollicitaties die incompleet zijn worden niet in behandeling genomen.               Het werk          Stage lopen in het Finance Transformation team betekent dat je samen met ons gaat werken aan het helpen van CFOs en senior Finance management bij het bepalen en uitvoeren van     hun     strategische verbeteragenda. Samen met ons team zul je aan toffe projecten en oplossingen bijdragen. Tijdens de stage maak je kennis met alle facetten van Finance consulting en help je direct mee om waarde te creëren. Je werkt mee aan projecten op het snijvlak van strategie, organisatie, processen, data en technologie. Je helpt om de     efficientie     en effectiviteit van Finance-afdelingen te vergroten door de organisatie te veranderen, processen te optimaliseren, of data en technology in te zetten op analytics, artificial intelligence (AI) en generative AI. Je werkt aan een breed scala van onderwerpen en presenteert de resultaten aan je projectteam en/of ons leiderschapsteam. Daarnaast help je mee klantworkshops voor te bereiden en eraan deel te nemen, markt- en bureauonderzoek uit te voeren en presentaties voor te bereiden.             Binnen al onze stages, bieden wij jou de mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen, oriënteren, relaties op te bouwen en inzicht te krijgen in hoe het is om als consultant te werken. Deze stage geeft je een unieke kans om meer te leren over Accenture, de impact op onze klanten, en onze dynamische bedrijfscultuur. Je krijgt de kans om kennis op te doen bij Finance-afdelingen binnen beurgenoteerde bedrijven, grote MKB en familiebedrijven in verschillende sectoren. Je krijgt toegang tot een breed scala aan leerervaringen om je professionele vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen. Zo kun je cursussen volgen om je vaardigheden op het snijvlak van business en technologie aan te scherpen. Deze stage biedt bovendien de ideale gelegenheid om te kijken of er een match is voor een vaste functie na afloop van de stageperiode.           Als werkgever zullen wij zo flexibel mogelijk zijn om jouw werk evenals academische benodigdheden te ondersteunen, wij helpen je graag met het kickstarten van je carrière.               Wie wij zijn             Strategy & Consulting           Het tempo van verandering zal nooit sneller zijn dan nu - en veel organisaties worstelen met nieuwe concurrentie uit onverwachte hoek. Wat betekent deze ontwikkeling, wat zijn de gevolgen, wat moet ik als bedrijf nu gaan doen om in de toekomst relevant te blijven?           Accenture Strategy & Consulting helpt bedrijven met deze vraagstukken. Jij geeft advies aan senior management - gebaseerd op data, kennis, ervaring en een innovatieve aanpak. Samen met een team van experts uit verschillende industrieën daag je uit en bedenk je oplossingen mét impact voor klanten en de maatschappij: om de disruptie voor te zijn en organisaties toekomstbestending te maken.           Strategy & Consulting is een van de vijf services waaruit one Accenture bestaat – de andere zijn Technology, Operations, Song en Industry X.                   Wie jij bent             Je studeert binnen maximaal 1 jaar af van je master (MSc/MA) aan een Nederlandse universiteit (e.g. Business Administration, (Innovation / Strategic) Management, Economics, Econometrics, Finance, Accounting, Law etc.).                Vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels (spreek- en schrijftaal)               Uitstekende VWO en WO resultaten                Sterke persoonlijkheid, presentatie en communicatieve vaardigheden                  Je werkt onafhankelijk en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, je bent creatief en neemt verantwoordelijkheid en je bent sterk intrinsiek gemotiveerd om betrokken te zijn bij je werk.                Bonus punten als jij…              Je hebt extra-curriculaire activiteiten gedaan (bijv. stages, bestuur, internationale ervaring)                Je hebt eerdere ervaring in een strategie of consulting rol                 Je hebt affiniteit met de laatste technologische, strategische, en consulting trends                Wat er voor jou in zit          Accenture is een wereldwijd bedrijf met een merk en reputatie van wereldklasse. Sviluppo di value proposition digitali  Contribuirai alla definizione di value proposition per prodotti e servizi digitali orientati all’ottimizzazione di processi e performance, ad esempio in ambiti quali MRO, energy management, compliance, navigazione, cybersecurity e opportunità di revenue uplift. Requisiti principali:    Laurea magistrale, conseguita o in corso, in discipline STEM, con preferenza per  Ingegneria Navale, Ingegneria Gestionale  o percorsi affini;    Forte interesse per il  mercato maritime , sia da una prospettiva business sia tecnologica;    Ottima conoscenza degli strumenti  Microsoft Office , in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel;    Buona  capacità di analisi , sintesi e strutturazione dei contenuti;     Inglese fluente , scritto e parlato;    Attitudine al  lavoro in team , proattività e desiderio di apprendere. jobs.title: Internship – Digital Product Strategy
jobs.description: Internship details     Period: 6 months      Hours per week: 40      Location: Hybrid (ITO office, Amsterdam and work from home)      Start date: February 2027    We’re opening our doors to great people who are excited to work with the world’s biggest brands on their toughest growth challenges. Accenture Song’s Design & Digital Products team is looking for a proactive intern! In our team, we create new products and reimagine existing ones to deliver better experiences for users and businesses. We are part of Accenture’s creative engine called Accenture Song, where we combine creativity, technology, and business insights to create experiences that drive real impact.    We offer two internship tracks:    Thesis Internship - focused on conducting research and writing your master thesis within the domain of Digital Product Strategy.     Working Internship - focused on gaining hands-on consulting experience by actively contributing to client work, innovation initiatives, and internal capability building.     Team    The Design & Digital Products team is part of Accenture Song. We’re an all-star team of growth strategists, creative designers, and product builders who thrive on turning bold ideas into impactful realities. We think, we plot, and we create products and experiences that help our clients solve problems and unlock new values. Our work spans the full product lifecycle: from envisioning future-fit strategies and building prototypes to launching products and scaling capabilities. Whether it’s crafting digital products that people love or improving business performance through technology, data and AI, we are passionate about building experiences and bridging the gap between brand promise and expectations.     Daily tasks     Thesis Internship : In this role, the focus will be on writing your master thesis in the relevant domain of Digital Product Strategy. In doing so, you’ll be supported by the dedicated people in our team. Alongside your thesis, you’ll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the Design & Digital Products domain at Accenture Song and explore the world of consultancy.       We’ll collaborate with you to define a thesis topic that aligns with our business needs, but most importantly, that interests and motivates you. This program will be leading you through your path at Accenture Song and will provide additional engagements, activities and projects to enhance your intern experience. Being part of the Song Talent Factory, you will:     Get professional guidance on finding the next step in your career;      Be part of one Song program where you are required to collaborate with other interns at Accenture Song from our different offerings (Commerce, AI & Data, Marketing and Service);      Work on a large internship long consulting project together with your STF group. Join us and bring to life bold ideas with the biggest impact through the unlimited potential of creativity, technology, and intelligence. jobs.description: Job Title:  Finance Intern    Department:   Finance    Job Status:   Non-Exempt    Compensation:      Direct Reports:  No        COMPANY OVERVIEW   CrossCountry Freight Solutions (CCFS) is an exceptional company with a mission to achieve universal prosperity with our Customers, Company, Team Members, & Communities. jobs.title: Intern, Finance - REM
jobs.description: Filiale exclusive de la Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec, CDPQ Infra agit à titre de donneur d’ouvrage et de maître d’oeuvre pour de grands projets d’infrastructures publiques. Nous assumons la responsabilité de toutes les phases des projets : conception, planification, financement, développement de projet, stratégie d’approvisionnement, réalisation et exploitation.  CDPQ Infra est notamment responsable du déploiement du Réseau express métropolitain (REM) dans le Grand Montréal et de la mise en œuvre du projet TramCité à Québec. CDPQ Infra est aussi membre du groupe Cadence, qui a remporté l’appel d’offres du gouvernement fédéral pour le projet de train à grande vitesse Alto dans le corridor Québec-Toronto.       Sommaire du rôle     Travaillant au sein de la vice-présidence Finances, la personne titulaire du poste assumera diverses tâches liées aux activités courantes en comptabilité.   Principales responsabilités    Participer aux activités entourant la fermeture des systèmes auxiliaires à chaque fin de période;  Effectuer le suivi de l’avancement de certains travaux de réalisation;  Participer au processus mensuel de contrôle des coûts pour la phase de réalisation du projet;  Manipuler les données financières par l’entremise d’outils d’automatisation (e.g. PowerQuery);  Agir comme personne-ressource pour toutes les questions relatives au processus de contrôle de coûts et de suivi budgétaire.     Exigences recherchées    Être inscrit.e dans un programme de 1er cycle (2e année ou plus);  Expérience de stage en finances (un atout);  Habiletés avec les outils de la suite Microsoft 365 (Excel avancé, PowerQuery, Power BI);  Excellente connaissance de la langue française, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.      Compétences      Excellente gestion des priorités et des échéanciers;  Autonomie et sens de l’initiative;  Curiosité intellectuelle et esprit méthodique;  Sens de la collaboration et contribution au travail en équipe.     Travailler chez CDPQ Infra, ça représente quoi ?    Une opportunité de travailler sur des projets concrets et d’envergure;  Un accès à une multitude de ressources et surtout à des professionnels de domaines variés;  Un espace de travail stimulant en plein cœur du centre-ville.      Note  : Nous contacterons uniquement les personnes retenues pour une entrevue.  CDPQ Infra désire offrir des chances d'emploi égales à toutes et à tous. Nous invitons les femmes, membres de minorités visibles et ethniques, autochtones et personnes handicapées à présenter leur candidature. Nous nous engageons également à poursuivre l'intégration de la diversité et à en faire une source d'enrichissement et de fierté pour l'ensemble de l'organisation. Veuillez SVP nous informer si votre condition actuelle nécessite des mesures d'adaptation au niveau du processus de recrutement.  Des études démontrent que les femmes et les membres de groupes traditionnellement sous-représentés ont tendance à appliquer sur un poste uniquement lorsqu’ils ou elles répondent à toutes les exigences. Si cette offre d’emploi vous motive, mais que vous ne correspondez pas à tous les critères, communiquez quand même avec nous !

jobs.description: About the job    This 6-month internship, starting in March 2027, takes place in one of our Boutiques in Brussels. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable recommendations to improve marketing outcomes.    Conduct analysis of marketing funnels and conversion pathways to identify opportunities for optimization. Support market research initiatives through data analysis and interpretation. Design and evaluate testing frameworks, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, and pilot programs.    Measure campaign effectiveness and attribution across channels and customer touchpoints. Strong understanding of marketing measurement, marketing attribution, customer analytics, and campaign performance evaluation.    Knowledge of business intelligence and analytics tools, including Power BI, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (MCI), SAP, Marquis, SQL, Excel, or comparable platforms.    Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, web analytics, customer journey analysis, and attribution methodologies.    Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.    Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and data storytelling skills.    Strong organizational and project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.    Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.      Minimum Qualifications     Pursuing Marketing, Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, or a related degree.    Ability to support customer acquisition, retention, digital marketing, or product marketing initiatives. jobs.title: Financial Intern
jobs.description: Career Area:  Enterprise Cross Functional    Job Description:     Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.       When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.      Caterpillar, en su búsqueda continua de apoyar el desarrollo de nuevos talentos, ofrece programas de prácticas con la intención de brindar a futuros nuevos profesionales la oportunidad de desarrollar proyectos de impacto dentro de nuestra organización. Con este programa, el estudiante maximiza la práctica de sus conocimientos y adquiere su primera experiencia profesional.        Sobre Cat Financial       Cat Financial es una subsidiaria de Caterpillar Inc., el fabricante líder mundial de equipos de construcción y minería, motores diésel y de gas natural fuera de carretera, turbinas de gas industriales y locomotoras diésel-eléctricas. Durante más de 40 años, Cat Financial ha proporcionado una amplia gama de soluciones de financiamiento a clientes y distribuidores Cat® para máquinas, motores, turbinas de gas Solar®, repuestos genuinos Cat y servicios. Con sede en Nashville, Tennessee, Cat Financial atiende a clientes a nivel mundial con oficinas y subsidiarias ubicadas en América del Norte y del Sur, Asia, Australia, Europa y África. Visita cat.com para obtener más información sobre Cat Financial.      Estamos haciendo posible el progreso sostenible, todos los días. Desde nuestro equipo de liderazgo dedicado hasta nuestros socios e internos innovadores, estamos trabajando constantemente para encontrar mejores formas de servir a nuestros distribuidores Cat, clientes y empleados.             El  pasante de Finanzas  desempeñará un papel clave en el apoyo a las iniciativas de transformación actualmente impulsadas por la compañía. Esta posición ofrece una oportunidad única para participar en proyectos orientados a la estandarización y mejora de procesos, contribuyendo a construir una organización más eficiente, escalable y enfocada en generar valor para el negocio. A través de esta experiencia, el estudiante adquirirá una comprensión práctica de los procesos de planificación financiera, forecasting, análisis de resultados y soporte a la toma de decisiones, participando activamente en iniciativas de mejora continua y transformación organizacional. Trabajando de manera cercana con el equipo de Finanzas, Planificación y Contabilidad, el pasante desarrollará habilidades analíticas, de resolución de problemas, documentación de procesos y gestión de iniciativas, obteniendo exposición directa a un entorno multinacional y de alto desempeño.              Qué harás:        Levantamiento de Procesos de planificación y análisis financiero:       Apoyar el levantamiento, mapeo y documentación de los principales procesos de planificación y análisis financiero, incluyendo Planning, Forecasting, Performance Reporting e Intercompany Charges.      Desarrollar procedimientos, diagramas de proceso, metodologías y documentación gráfica para mejorar la consistencia y sostenibilidad de las actividades de planificación y análisis financiero.      Colaborar en la creación de un repositorio y materiales de referencia para el área.       Identificación de oportunidades de mejora:       Analizar procesos, flujos de información y actividades recurrentes para identificar oportunidades de simplificación, estandarización y mejora.      Participar en revisiones de procesos junto a miembros del equipo y stakeholders del negocio.      Desarrollar recomendaciones orientadas a aumentar la eficiencia, transparencia y efectividad de las actividades de FP&A.       Implementación de iniciativas de mejora:       Liderar la implementación de iniciativas de mejora previamente identificadas y priorizadas por el área.      Apoyar proyectos relacionados con automatización, inteligencia artificial, herramientas digitales, visualización de datos u optimización de procesos.      Medir y documentar los beneficios obtenidos a partir de las iniciativas implementadas.       Análisis y soporte al negocio:       Colaborar en actividades de planificación financiera, análisis de resultados y reporting.      Apoyar la preparación de información para revisiones de desempeño y procesos de planificación.      Participar en proyectos especiales y solicitudes ad hoc del equipo de planificación y análisis financiero. jobs.title: Financial Analyst Intern
jobs.description: Cerved è la tech company italiana che, grazie a segnali predittivi unici e a un patrimonio esclusivo di dati e analytics, supporta la crescita sostenibile, la gestione del rischio e la trasformazione digitale di imprese e istituzioni.  Con Cerved Rating Agency, elaboriamo valutazioni sul merito di credito, rating ESG e analisi sulle emissioni di debito.  Dal 2021 Cerved è parte di ION Group, uno dei più grandi operatori FinTech internazionali.    Per supportare il team Finanza Agevolata, siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in stage, interessata ad approfondire i principali strumenti di finanza agevolata, credito bancario e sostegno alle imprese. La persona selezionata affiancherà il team di analisti nelle attività di gestione e monitoraggio delle pratiche, collaborando quotidianamente con imprese e istituti bancari.  Se sei un laureando o neolaureato in discipline economiche o giuridiche e desideri muovere i primi passi in un contesto dinamico e altamente specializzato, questa è l'opportunità giusta per te.     Cosa farai      Collaborerai all'analisi dei bilanci e alla verifica dei requisiti di ammissibilità delle pratiche di finanza agevolata, supportando le attività istruttorie e le valutazioni preliminari.    Supporterai il monitoraggio delle pratiche e il controllo della documentazione, verificandone la completezza e il rispetto delle scadenze previste.    Contribuirai alla gestione operativa delle richieste attraverso l'utilizzo dei portali dedicati agli strumenti di finanza agevolata e il confronto con gli enti gestori.    Ti interfaccerai con imprese e istituti bancari per la raccolta e la verifica della documentazione necessaria all'avanzamento delle pratiche.    Collaborerai con il team per garantire un processo efficiente, conforme alle normative e orientato alla qualità del servizio.       Chi sei      Stai per laurearti o hai conseguito una laurea in Economia, Giurisprudenza o discipline affini;    Hai un interesse concreto per l'analisi finanziaria, il credito bancario e la normativa legata agli strumenti di finanza agevolata;    Hai buone capacità comunicative e relazionali e ti trovi a tuo agio nell'interfacciarti con imprese, istituti bancari e diversi interlocutori;    Hai una buona conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office;    Hai una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata;    A guidarti sono precisione, affidabilità e attenzione ai dettagli;    Ti contraddistinguono spirito di collaborazione e attitudine al lavoro di squadra;    Costituisce un plus aver approfondito durante il percorso di studi temi relativi a bilancio, diritto commerciale, diritto fallimentare o Codice della Crisi d'Impresa;    Costituisce un plus una conoscenza di base della Centrale dei Rischi.       La sede di lavoro: San Donato Milanese, Bologna, Torino.   Modalità di lavoro: ibrida.    È previsto un rimborso spese mensile di Euro 800.      Cerved Group garantisce (ai sensi del D.Lgs 198/2006, D.Lgs.215/2003 e D.Lgs.216/2003) pari opportunità di accesso al lavoro a tutt* i/le candidat* e si impegna a favorire il rispetto delle diversità e l’inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

Job Description                                       The program allows interns the opportunity to gain hands-on experience related to their field of study by working on meaningful projects alongside Children’s professionals. Intern responsibilities may include project management, event planning and support, logistics, data base management, research, and analysis. Interns may explore career paths and apply for full-time positions upon successful completion of the program.      Experience    Research area: research experience necessary either through previous internship, work experience, or course work; practical knowledge about the conduct of research principals required      Preferred Qualifications    N/A      Education    Clinical Focus:    College student with at least two years in a health sciences related program, such as pre-med, nursing, biomedical engineering, biology, chemistry, or statistics, or post graduate student working toward a Master’s of Science in public health or medical degree      Non-Clinical Focus:    College or graduate student that is currently working towards a Bachelor or Master’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration or other related field, required      Certification Summary    No professional certifications required      Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities    Organized, detail oriented; Able to prioritize time sensitive assignments  Creative and flexible; Able to adapt to change  Self-starter; Able to make decisions independently  Strong verbal and written communication skills; Strong interpersonal and presentation skills  Able to work well with diverse groups, comfortable interacting with all levels  Able to represent Children’s in a mature and professional manner  Willing to work long hours that could include evenings and weekends, if applicable to internship  Proficient with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Power Point, Access, Outlook) or other applications as required  Able to travel throughout expanded metro Atlanta area; Must provide reliable transportation, if applicable to internship      Clinical Focus:    Knowledge of medical terminology useful  Knowledge of basic statistical software useful      Job Responsibilities    Develops and implements projects as assigned, which could include events, activities, programs, or research studies. jobs.title: Operations Internship (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: Summer Internship Program Overview     Cardinal Health’s Summer Internship Program is a structured 10-12 week experience designed for undergraduate students who will be entering their senior year and are eager to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll work on meaningful, business-critical projects that contribute to real outcomes while gaining exposure to the healthcare industry.    What you’ll gain:   Hands-on experience through impactful projects  Exposure to Cardinal Health’s business and culture  Development of leadership and professional skills  Networking opportunities with peers and leaders  A chance to interview for full-time roles upon successful completion     Who we’re looking for:   Undergraduate students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028  Curious, driven, and eager to learn  Interested in a career in the healthcare industry      Program Highlights      Real-World Experience  Interns collaborate with Cardinal Health professionals, business partners, customers, and vendors on impactful projects and daily responsibilities. Each intern also serves on a planning committee to enhance leadership skills and concludes the summer by presenting their work to business leaders.     Professional Development  Interns participate in a formal mentoring program, connect with employees across the organization, and attend workshops to strengthen business acumen. The program also provides opportunities to explore full-time career paths.     Networking Opportunities  Through the Executive Speaker Series and various networking events, interns engage with senior leaders and build relationships with professionals across the company.     Community & Camaraderie  Interns participate in social, team-building, and community service events designed to build a strong peer network and enrich the overall internship experience.     Job Description Summary      Location:  Aurora, Illinois   Start Date:  May 17 or 24, 2027   Hours:  Approximately 40 hours a week for a minimum of 10 weeks    As an  Operations Intern , you could potentially support the organization in several of the following ways:   Partner with site leaders to identify, analyze, and implement new or improved processes  Document and present solutions to site leadership to make our processes more efficient, consistent and cost effective  Develop, optimize, measure, and maintain performance and productivity  Assist and collaborate with leaders in functional teams such as receiving, picking, packing, shipping, staging, transporting, storage, delivery, etc.  Assist in the management of daily warehouse operations, optimizing workflow and increasing productivity  Exposure to processing orders including accurately picking, performing quality control checks, sorting, consolidating freight, building, and wrapping pallets, packing, loading, and preparing orders for shipment  Cross-training in multiple areas of the warehouse and participating in projects as needed  Analyze existing key performance indicators (KPI)  Design and document workflows to ensure operational effectiveness  Identify and develop reporting capabilities and data visualization tools to analyze metrics and ensure operational effectiveness  Participate in a Kaizen event and other continuous improvement initiatives  Work directly on the warehouse floor each day to observe, support, and improve operational processes while gaining firsthand experience in warehouse and supply chain operations.      Accountabilities in this role    Demonstrate strong analytical skills and attention to detail in all tasks  Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization  Maintain a proactive, results-oriented approach to work  Prioritize tasks efficiently, recognize urgency, and consistently meet deadlines  Work independently with moderate guidance, showing initiative and ownership  Adapt quickly to changing priorities and evolving business needs      Qualifications   To be considered for the Cardinal Health Summer 2027 Internship Program, candidates should meet a combination of the following criteria:   Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Management, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or related field, preferred  Expected graduation between December 2027 and June 2028, preferred  Knowledge of supply chain principles, Lean Six Sigma or other improvement techniques, preferred  Comfortable working in a warehouse environment  Demonstrated leadership, communication and analytical skills  Participation in extracurricular activities, community organizations and/or professional associations  Must have unlimited work authorization in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future     Please note, applicants may redact any age-related information.     Pay rate:  $23.00 per hour   Bonus eligible:  No   Benefits:  Medical, dental and vision coverage, Paid time off plan, Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay   Application window anticipated to close:  02/28/2027 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.       Candidates who are back-to-work, people with disabilities, without a college degree, and Veterans are encouraged to apply. jobs.description: We’re building a      relationship-oriented      bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.                                                                            At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.                                                                           To learn more about CIBC, please visit  CIBC.com                                           About the Program    Our Summer Internship is a 10-12 week program designed to provide hands-on experience and exposure to the dynamic world of commercial banking and technology. As an intern, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, participate in real projects, and gain insight into how technology drives innovation and client solutions at CIBC.      Program Highlights:      Leader Connect Sessions:  Meet with members of our executive and leadership teams.      Employee and Peer Connects:  Build your network and connect with peers, business leaders and CIBC employees.      Learning & Development:  Access a variety of learning platforms to support your professional growth.      What you'll be doing   CIBC’s Commercial Banking team is dedicated to supporting the financial needs of our business clients through expert advice, innovative solutions, and relationship-focused service. As an intern with one of our Commercial Banking teams, you’ll support credit analysis, financial research, and client service activities. You’ll work closely with Relationship Managers and Credit Analysts to help deliver high-quality insights and service to our clients. You’ll also contribute to projects such as market research, data management, and process improvement initiatives, gaining hands-on experience in commercial banking. This internship is designed to help you build your skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment while learning from experienced professionals. Please note that this is a general application for the CIBC U.S. Summer Intern Program within Commercial Banking and Commercial Real Estate, and more details on the team and required skills will be shared during interviews.    At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.     How you'll succeed     Support credit analysis  - Assist with financial analysis, credit reviews, and report preparation to support client needs and internal decision-making.   Collaborate with partners  - Work closely with Relationship Managers, Credit Analysts, and other team members to support client service and project delivery.   Contribute to team initiatives  - Participate in market research, data clean-up, and business case reviews that help drive results for clients and the bank.   Build your knowledge  - Learn new systems, tools, and processes, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills and performance.   Deliver with accuracy  - Maintain a high level of attention to detail and help ensure quality and consistency across deliverables.    Who you are     You're analytical.  You enjoy investigating problems, working with information, and turning details into meaningful insights.   You're collaborative.  You work well with others and are motivated by shared success in a team environment.   You're detail-oriented.  You know accuracy matters, and you apply critical thinking to support strong decision-making.   You have relevant education.  You're currently enrolled in a degree or diploma program in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related field.   You have technical confidence.  You're comfortable using spreadsheets and data management tools, and experience with financial analysis is an asset.   Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.     At CIBC, we offer a competitive total rewards package.  This role has an expected hourly rate of $25.00 per hour for the market based on experience, qualifications, and location of the position. CIBC offers a full range of benefits and programs to meet our intern's needs; including 401(k) contribution, Paid Time Off (including Sick Leave and Vacation), and Holidays, in addition to other special perks reserved for our team members.       This position does not offer visa sponsorship.    #LI-TA      At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths, ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential.              What you need to know    CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact  Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com   You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.  We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills tests (such as simulation, coding, MS Office). Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.
