jobs.title: Project Manager, Campus Business Operations
jobs.description: Engineering a world of possibilities   Mines is pleased to announce the opening of a new position leading project management efforts across campus business functions.   The Project Manager for Campus Business Operations is a member of the Finance, Administration and Operations team at Colorado School of Mines. Reporting to the Deputy Chief Financial Officer, the person in this role manages cross-functional technology and business process improvement projects. The role integrates with Finance, Business Services, Human Resources, IT, Compliance, and Operations, academic units, and administrative teams to create operational excellence across Mines. The PM applies a consistent, repeatable project delivery approach and contributes to practical improvements in project management, business process redesign, organizational change management, and continuous improvement practices.   The person in this role manages prioritized projects from needs assessment /discovery through implementation, operational transition, and closure. You’ll establish clear scope, goals, project plans, resource needs, status reporting, and evaluation procedures; ensure current-state workflows are mapped; identifies inefficiencies and policy constraints; ensures business requirements are translated into future-state processes and technical configuration needs; and coordinates testing, readiness, training, communications, and adoption.  This position is eligible for hybrid work with an expectation of at least three days per week on campus in Golden, Colorado, based on business needs and in accordance with Mines Flexible Work Arrangements policy.   Primary Responsibilities    Project Delivery & Business Process Redesign    Manage the full lifecycle of assigned FA&O business process improvement projects from scope definition and chartering through planning, execution, testing, implementation, stabilization, operational transition, post-implementation review, and tracking improvement metrics across projects.     Develop and maintain project plans with measurable goals and objectives, schedules, milestones, resource needs, budgets as applicable, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, scope and change-control records, evaluation methods, and required deliverables.     Guide and manage project execution across functional owners, product and technical teams, vendors, and campus stakeholders; clarify roles and decision rights, coordinate resources and capacity, resolve roadblocks, and escalate conflicts or delivery risks when necessary.     Facilitate discovery workshops to map current-state processes, identify bottlenecks, manual effort, policy or control constraints, and customer pain points. Independently research solutions form other universities or organizations to aid in the discovery phase.  Partner with functional sponsor and IT partners to assess technical needs and system capabilities on campus.    Monitor dependencies, integration points, competing priorities, and impacts to shared resources or campus operations, and escalate alignment concerns through appropriate FA&O leaders and IT Project Management Office. Provide current and future state process maps to facilitate documentation and clarity.     Provide timely, audience-appropriate project reports and dashboards to sponsors, project teams, and governance bodies.      Organizational Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement    Develop and support stakeholder engagement and organizational change activities that build sponsorship, prepare impacted users and operational teams, address adoption risks, and support sustained use of redesigned business processes.     Partner with FA&O Content Manager to deliver audience-specific communications, training, standard operating procedures, job aids, and other adoption resources.     Build and maintain effective relationships across FA&O, academic units, administrative teams, vendors, and campus leadership; facilitate consultation, advocacy, decision-making, and issue resolution throughout the transformation journey.      Prioritization & Governance Support    Document business needs, expected outcomes, customer impact, risk, effort, resource needs, dependencies, and expected value.     Confirm the business need, expected outcomes, accountable sponsor, process owner, decision authority, resource commitment, and approval to proceed.     Work with sponsors, project teams, and governance bodies to identify priority or resource conflicts, confirm continued sponsorship, and recommend whether assigned initiatives should proceed, pause, or be reprioritized as institutional needs and capacity change.      Benefits Realization & Performance Measurement    Define measurable success criteria and baseline metrics such as cycle time, error rates, manual effort, service levels, user experience, and cost; compare them with post-implementation results and report outcomes to sponsors and campus partners.     Use standard benefit-realization methods, dashboards, and reporting templates, and partner with operational owners to monitor sustained performance, identify corrective actions, and document improvement opportunities.      PMO Practice Support & Continuous Improvement    Contribute to a consistent business process improvement practice with the IT Project Management Office by using and helping refine delivery methods, playbooks, reusable templates, process-mapping approaches, quality standards, project management tools, and measures for improving the practice over time.     Promote project, change management, and process improvement best practices across assigned project teams, Information Technology, and campus partners; share practical guidance and lessons learned with peers and partners.     Stay current with emerging practices and technologies in enterprise systems, business process re-engineering, continuous improvement, project management, and organizational change management.            Minimum Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Corporate Development Intern (MBA)
jobs.location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States of America
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 4 Jan 2027     Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.       A Day in the Life                         The Medtronic Corporate Development group has primary responsibility for Medtronic Corporate Development projects including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, minority investments, technology licenses and divestitures.  This role is fast paced, dynamic and provides unique access to Medtronic leadership.   A Day in the Life  The Corporate Development Intern participates in the Medtronic Corporate Development activity by performing market analysis, financial analysis, deal structuring and negotiation, due diligence coordination, and preparation for presentations. The Intern is responsible for executing project requirements, financial modeling and preparing and presenting proposals and recommendations to management. In addition, the Intern may interact with senior leadership on special projects. The Intern is required to work in close partnership with project teams that generally include personnel from all levels of leadership and in various corporate and/or business unit functional departments including business development, marketing, research, finance, tax, law, human resources , purchasing and procurement, information technology, quality assurance, and regulatory. The Intern generally is required to participate in 4 to 6 active projects at any one time, often times under tight timelines.   Why Join Corporate Development?   •  Help shape Medtronic’s inorganic growth strategy and long-term portfolio • Gain experience across acquisitions, investments, partnerships, licensing transactions, joint ventures, and divestitures • Evaluate opportunities across Medtronic’s global businesses and therapeutic areas • Partner directly with senior executives, business leaders, and experienced transaction professionals • Build expertise at the intersection of strategy, finance, healthcare innovation, and transaction execution • Develop leadership capabilities that can support future opportunities across Medtronic   A Day in the Life   •  Evaluate acquisitions, strategic investments, partnerships, licensing opportunities, joint ventures, and divestitures in support of Medtronic's long-term strategic objectives • Assess the strategic, financial, operational, and organizational implications of potential transactions, including risks, synergies, and integration considerations • Perform financial analysis and develop valuation, transaction, and scenario models to support investment recommendations • Present strategic analyses, transaction recommendations, and key findings to senior leaders • Lead core transaction workstreams and support cross-functional diligence processes from evaluation through execution • Gain experience across Medtronic's businesses and the broader medical technology ecosystem while developing future leadership capabilities    Must Have: Minimum Requirements  - Currently enrolled in a fulltime MBA program (class of Spring 2028) - 5+ years of experience with an MBA - Eligible to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis without the need for future sponsorship for an employment visa - Participants must be able to participate full time as part of our intern cohort in the Minneapolis office 4 days a week:  Monday, June 14 - Friday, August 20th 2027   Nice to Have:  - Medical device or healthcare industry experience - M&A and strong valuation experience - Strong leadership skills - Excellent oral and written communication skills - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and lead others - Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage several projects simultaneously - Ability to perform under pressure and in a very dynamic environment - A high degree of initiative and motivation - Strong strategic thinking - Ability to understand complex technical product informatin  For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.       Physical Job Requirements     The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.     The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role. If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity! Help design simple, repeatable data acquisition routines, such as SharePoint lists and Power Automate flows, that feed reporting and analytics.     Data Preparation and Structuring    Support the collection, cleansing, consolidation and structuring of workforce data from multiple sources to produce reliable datasets for reporting and analysis. jobs.description: Job Description       Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?      Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.      As an organization we are committed to developing the next generation of Makers and Bakers. Joining us at an early career stage in our fast paced and ever changing environment will enable you to do more, learn more and grow more. You will be encouraged to step outside your comfort zone– you may even surprise yourself! We will ensure you are given the support you need to be at your best and enable you to be yourself and bring passion and personality. Here you can lean in and speak up and bring your own flavor.       Mondelēz International was recognized as one of the Top 100 Intern Programs in the US in 202  6     by Yello &     WayUp     and one of the Best Companies for New Graduates by Forbes.                         As a Finance Intern, you will gain hands-on experience across different areas of Finance, including Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and business performance management. You will work closely with Finance teams and business partners to analyze financial information, develop insights, and support decisions that help drive business performance and growth.                Throughout the internship, you may support the preparation of weekly and monthly financial reports, forecasts, budgets, dashboards, and ad hoc financial analyses. Projects may include analyzing profitability across brands, categories, customers, or channels; developing business cases and financial models;     identifying     key performance drivers; and providing greater visibility into areas such as costs, waste, and their     financial impact  . Interns may also support month-, quarter-, or year-end reporting activities depending on the timing and needs of the business.                Interns may also contribute to finance digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives, including building or enhancing dashboards, trackers, reporting tools, and financial models that improve the accuracy and efficiency of financial planning and reporting. jobs.title: Private Markets MBA Intern Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Founded in 1939, Neuberger is an employee-owned, private, independent investment manager with approximately 3,000 employees across 26 countries. As of September 30, 2026, the firm manages $616 billion across equities, fixed income, private markets, real estate and hedge fund portfolios for global institutions, advisors and individuals.         The firm is proud to be recognized for its commitment to its two constituents, clients and employees. Again, in 2025, Neuberger was named the Best Asset Manager for Institutional Investors in the U.S. (Crisil Coalition Greenwich) and the #1 Best Place to Work in Money Management (   Pensions & Investments  , firms with more than 1,000 employees).      Neuberger Private Equity      Neuberger Private Equity is one of the largest private equity managers in the world with over $200 billion in AUM. Summer Associates will work as part of Neuberger’s Primaries and Co-Investments team, which manages over $95 billion of investor commitments.  With a flexible, global investment mandate, the team can invest across a wide range of asset classes, geographies, and industries. This is a fast-growing platform that has significant capital to invest.            Responsibilities      The role is based in New York and offers an exciting opportunity to be part of Neuberger’s private equity platform. Our culture fosters an entrepreneurial environment and all junior/mid-level members have constant interaction with senior leadership.  As part of a deal team, the Summer Associate will gain a broad experience and contribute to every aspect of our investment cycle. Key responsibilities include:     Screening and conducting due diligence of primary and co-investment opportunities    Performing in-depth research and financial analysis on companies and assets from various stages, sectors, and geographies    Preparation of due diligence materials and investment committee memos    Interacting with external parties, including private equity sponsors, industry experts and investment bankers, as well as with other areas of the firm internally, to enhance due diligence insights and identify new opportunities    Monitoring and conducting analysis on the firm’s existing investments          Qualified candidates will have:     Targeting current MBA students graduating in Winter 2027 or Summer 2028    Excellent academic credentials and GPA    At least 4 years of professional experience in top-tier investment banking and/or private equity. Buyside experience strongly preferred    Strong judgment, critical thinking and written skills; ability to articulate and present ideas effectively both orally and in written form    Show initiative and creativity in approach to problem solving; demonstrated experience in conducting research and interacting with others to develop solutions    Ability to multi-task with a fine-tuned attention to detail    Team-player attitude and a desire to work on a wide range of projects      #LI-MW1      #LI-Hybrid    
Applicants must be authorized and have the right to work in the country where the role is located without the need for current or future sponsorship.      Compensation Details    The salary range for this role is $185,000-$185,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in the job posting location.  An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, business sector, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, market benchmarking data, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. This job is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, which, along with base salary and retirement contributions, is part of our total comprehensive package. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, retirement, life insurance and other benefits to eligible employees.     Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, production, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.       Neuberger is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: An exciting career awaits you      At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.      Overview:    Marathon Petroleum Company LP (MPC) offers internship and co-op opportunities to high-performing college students who want meaningful hands-on experiences in their fields of study. The following core values guide MPC’s approach to doing business: Safety & Environmental Stewardship, Integrity, Respect, Inclusion, and Collaboration. Interns and co-ops work side by side with experienced professionals as contributing members of diverse work teams who create value for the company’s shareholders. MPC believes that how we conduct our business is just as important as the bottom line.      Responsibilities:    As an MPC Commercial intern, you could be placed within one of the departments as described below. Job shadowing and volunteer opportunities are available during internships.  Some travel may be required in each of these roles.     Scheduling:   We are seeking a detail-oriented Scheduling intern to support our team in optimizing resource allocation and production schedules. The Intern will be responsible for scheduling the delivery of light products, feedstocks, and biofuels by pipeline or waterborne transportation to third party and company locations to meet customer’s demand (sales forecast). The intern will coordinate pipeline, barge and/or tanker movements for appropriate timing, batch size and sequence of product shipments to optimize the supply of the available products from refineries and terminals, while also minimizing transportation costs and ensuring quality. They will monitor inventories at terminals and refineries daily and adjust shipping schedules to avoid shortages and the use of excess working capital. Additionally, they will develop improved scheduling methods to efficiently utilize company resources, optimize inventory levels, and minimize transportation costs as well as coordinate the communications between terminals, Commercial, Exchange and Product Quality regarding any inventory or operational issue.   Desired major and or minor – Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance or other related disciplines.      Marketing:   Corporate Office-based interns will support the marketing team by analyzing market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities. Your role will involve gathering and interpreting data, creating reports, and assisting in the development of marketing strategies and/or campaigns. This position offers hands-on experience in market research and data-driven decision-making within a dynamic Commercial environment. Interns will also be provided with the opportunity for exposure to various parts of our business such as: Product Quality, Governmental Affairs, Business Development, Terminal, Transport & Rail.  Field-based interns will spend most of their time in the field learning the job responsibilities of a Territory Manager. The intern may travel to various customer offices or dealer gasoline locations with a Territory Manager, assist in prospecting for new customers, and assume responsibility for projects/studies relating to station financials and operation. In addition, the intern will have the opportunity for exposure to different components of the Commercial organization and other corporate components such as: Product Quality, Governmental Affairs, Business Development, Terminal, Transport & Rail.   Desired major and or minor – Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Finance, Business Analytics or other related disciplines.      Analytics:   We are looking for a motivated Analytics Intern to support our data-driven initiatives and gain hands-on experience in the Commercial organization. The intern will assist in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing data to uncover trends and generate actionable insights. Key responsibilities include helping to create reports and dashboards, conducting preliminary data analysis, and supporting ongoing data-related projects. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn from experienced analysts and contribute to real-world business decisions. Ideal candidates are detail-oriented, have strong analytical skills, and are eager to develop their expertise in data analysis and visualization.  Analytics interns could support one of the following groups/commodities: Data Analytics & Strategy (DAS), Prediction & Optimization, Commercial Risk, Pricing, Renewables, Liquified Petroleum Gas exports, Pet Coke/Sulfur, Natural Gas Liquids (NGL), and Petrochemicals.   Desired major and or minor – Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Science or other related disciplines.      Coordinating:   We are seeking an organized and proactive Coordinating Intern to assist in managing and streamlining various operational and project-related tasks. The intern will support coordination efforts across departments, ensuring smooth communication and efficient execution of projects. Responsibilities include scheduling meetings, tracking project progress, preparing reports, and assisting with administrative tasks. This role offers a great opportunity to develop organizational and multitasking skills while contributing to the success of diverse projects. Ideal candidates should be detail-oriented, possess strong communication skills, and be eager to gain hands-on experience in project/program coordination. jobs.title: Intern/Co-op - Commercial Marine Operator (Summer 2027)
jobs.description: An exciting career awaits you      At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.     Overview:    Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) offers internship and co-op opportunities to high-performing college students who want meaningful hands-on experiences in their fields of study. The following core values guide MPC’s approach to doing business: safety and environmental stewardship; integrity; inclusion; collaboration; and excellence. Interns and co-ops work side by side with experienced professionals as contributing members of diverse work teams who create value for the company’s shareholders. MPC believes that how we conduct our business is just as important as the bottom line.    MPC's Global Marine organization is offering a high-impact  Commercial Marine Operator Intern  role for students who want real responsibility in global vessel and cargo operations. You will join a team at the center of domestic and international waterborne logistics, helping move energy products safely and efficiently around the world.​       Responsibilities:    As part of the Commercial Marine Operations team, you will:   Support real-time voyages for Marathon time-chartered vessels, helping manage day-to-day operations and logistics for waterborne cargoes.​  Coordinate with Captains, Brokers, Chartering, Trading, Scheduling, Agents, Tug providers, Bunker Vendors, and Terminals to keep ships and cargoes on track.​  Gain exposure to Marine Vetting, Port Management, and the commercial aspects of the Global Marine business.​  Split your time between job shadowing, hands-on voyage management work, and a focused project that drives value for the team.​    You will report to the Commercial Marine Operations Manager and work closely with a dedicated mentor committed to creating a positive, engaging, and educational experience.​    Skills Gained:   During this internship, you can expect to:   Develop a strong understanding of commercial marine operations, shipping logistics, and how decisions impact real-world voyages.​  Strengthen key professional skills such as verbal and written communication, prioritization, multi-tasking, analytics, problem solving, risk management, decision-making, and teamwork. jobs.description: Public Investments – Quantitative Analyst Internship (undergraduate-level)     Job Description  Northwestern Mutual's Public Investment Department seeks a Quantitative Analyst Intern to join us for the summer of 2027 and play a pivotal role in building out tools and conducting analyses that help shape our investment processes. We manage over $130 billion in fixed income assets, and you will collaborate directly with Portfolio Managers, Traders, and Credit Analysts to develop cutting-edge solutions.     Principal Responsibilities:   You'll have the opportunity to leverage your unique strengths and interests within a flexible role that spans data, modeling, visualization, and applications. Your activities will center around driving investment performance through innovative improvements to our investment processes, such as relative value analysis, portfolio construction, trading tools, risk measurement, and more.      Build & maintain data models:  Collaborate with data engineers to onboard new data sources, design and implement dbt SQL models for data cleaning and integration, and write robust data quality tests to ensure data integrity.   Develop interactive data visualizations:  Create insightful dashboards and applications using Tableau and Streamlit to effectively communicate data and model outputs to the department’s investment professionals.   Design and implement machine learning models:  Utilize machine learning and AI techniques to develop predictive models, optimize model parameters, research new signals, and deploy models into the Snowflake production environment.   Apply quantitative methods:  Leverage quantitative methods such as portfolio optimization, Monte Carlo simulation, risk measurement, and backtesting to enhance various aspects of the investment process.   Collaborate effectively:  Work closely with Portfolio Managers, Traders, and Credit Analysts to better identify attractive investment opportunities through efficient data delivery, advanced models, and intuitive dashboards.      Job Requirements:    Progress towards a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Quantitative Finance, Computer/Data Science, Finance, Mathematics).  Strong development skills in languages such as SQL, Python, Streamlit, dbt, etc.  Excellent data manipulation and data visualization skills.  Experience with software development practices such as version control and CI/CD pipelines is preferred.  Experience using Bloomberg and BlackRock Aladdin is a plus.      Interpersonal Skills    Passion for the art and science of investing.  Effective oral and written communication skills.   Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving ability.  High degree of self-motivation, passion, and a drive to learn.    About the Internship Program  Internship candidates can expect a fulltime onsite internship program, running from June 2027 to August 2027. Carefully selected from universities across the country, our interns bring distinctive ideas and perspectives to our organization. About the Public Investment Department   Northwestern Mutual’s Public Investments Department manages over $130 billion in investment grade and high yield fixed income assets backing NM’s General Account insurance products and retirement plan assets, and oversees about half of the company’s total General Account assets. The team actively manages these assets with a goal of generating long-run total returns in excess of benchmarks to drive policyholder value. Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  Looking for a great place to work?  You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment.  Come explore Novanta.       About Novanta    This position is part of Novanta’s Corporate and Shared Services global teams.  Included in Corporate and Shared Services are the business functions including Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Information Technology, Legal, Compliance, Corporate Development and Corporate Marketing. The Corporate and Shared Services teams work closely with all Novanta business units in Europe and US to support operating initiatives contributing to the organization’s financial success.    Summary    The role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across various accounting functions starting with Accounts Payables.    Responsibilities:     Invoice Processing - Sorts and categorizes emails based on relevance to accounts payable processes. - Updates status of incoming email handling in a central AP tracking tool. - Performs initial visual check of invoice document readability and completeness. - Checks invoice field formats and values against system data validation rules  - Verifies correctness of vendor and PO number linkage in invoice data. - Verifies that supplier VAT number and bank details match master data records. - Reviews electronic and scanned invoice entries for data completeness in ERP system. - Logs indexing errors found during daily checks in established error tracking tool. - Escalates invoices with discrepancies or missing data according to escalation protocol. - Flags urgent or SLA-sensitive emails and escalates if not processed within target time. - Identifies invoices that are overdue or stuck at a workflow stage beyond expected timelines. - Identifies invoices or transactions that deviate from standard AP procedures. - Flags urgent or exception cases for escalation to Medior/Senior staff. - Flags invoices not meeting compliance requirements and routes them to AP Medior/Senior for exception handling.  Process Excellence & SME: Identifies workflow issue in invoice processing system.  Month-End Close Activities: Updates list of unprocessed invoices with proposal what should be accrued and what not to be accrued.  Audit & Compliance - Logs simple process issues or improvement ideas for documentation update queue. - Validates vendor information and provides the supporting documentation to master data team.  Documentation & Knowledge Sharing  - Records step-by-step AP procedure in standardized documentation templates. - Updates process documentation based on recent workflow changes.  Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Clarifies missing or unclear purchase order information with procurement team.     Required Education, Skills, and Competencies      Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting/Finance or a related field (current student status is a must).  Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions).  Fluent English, Czech is a big plus.   Any experience in accounting or with accounting software is a plus.  Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret data from various sources and problem-solving skills.  Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.  Strong communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to manage time effectively and Self-learning capabilities.  Ability to find solutions, not only causes.  Eligible to work legally in Czechia (permanent residency/free access to the job market).      We offer     Internship (part-time job) with flexible working time which is compatible with studies.  Long-term internship with fixed duration 1 year.  Creative, innovative & friendly work environment, great team, new offices     #LI-JM1  #LI-Onsite      Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.    Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

Graduate Student Intern (Spring Semester) – Commercial Vehicle Logistics and Data Science
jobs.description: Posting Title   Graduate Student Intern (Spring Semester) – Commercial Vehicle Logistics and Data Science  .     Location   CO - Golden  .     Position Type   Intern (Fixed Term)  .     Hours Per Week   20  .    Working at NLR  NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.   Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.    At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.         Job Description    Seeking a part-time PhD candidate intern to work with researchers in the NLR Center for Integrated Mobility Sciences on simulation, optimization, and data-driven modeling of freight terminals, rail networks, and other logistics-intensive sites such as mines. Work will center on ALTRIOS, NLR’s open-source rail system simulation tool, and ALTRIOS-LIFTS, an event-based framework for simulating operations, equipment, and energy use at multi-modal freight terminals and other work sites. Specific tasks may include:        Assist NLR researchers on projects providing insights into freight and logistics systems, with a focus on how site operations, equipment choices, and infrastructure investments affect throughput, energy use, and cost.         Develop and enhance simulation models of multi-modal freight terminals (rail, truck, and marine) and other logistics sites such as mines, representing process steps, equipment fleets, shift schedules, and charging or refueling infrastructure.         Model interactions between freight terminals and the broader rail system, including train arrivals and departures, terminal and yard capacity, dwell times, and how terminal operations affect line-haul performance and energy use.         Formulate and implement mathematical optimization and scheduling approaches for problems such as equipment assignment, train and crane scheduling, fleet sizing, and charging infrastructure sizing.       Apply machine learning and AI methods to tasks such as calibrating simulation models against real-world data, building surrogate models for rapid scenario analysis, and identifying patterns in operational data.         Process and analyze real-world operational datasets, such as equipment data logging, terminal activity records, and train movement data, and develop data visualizations and interactive dashboards that communicate results to technical and industry stakeholders.         Document methods and assumptions, contribute to open-source code, and assist with preparing peer-reviewed publications along with high-quality technical reports and presentations.        .     Basic Qualifications   Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.  Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.  Post Undergraduate: Earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.  Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.  Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year. Graduate + PhD: Completed master’s degree and enrolled as PhD student from an accredited institution.    Please Note: • Applicants are responsible for uploading official or unofficial school transcripts, as part of the application process. • If selected for position, a letter of recommendation will be required as part of the hiring process. • Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.    * Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.      Additional Required Qualifications     Proficiency in Python for data analysis and computational modeling         Experience with logistics, scheduling, and operations research problems in the areas of rail and/or freight terminal systems         Experience with mathematical optimization, machine learning, and discrete-event or agent-based simulation         Ability to create clear and accurate data visualizations         Experience with collaborative software development using GitHub         Good written and verbal communication skills             Preferred Qualifications      Demonstrated ability to develop and execute analysis projects in the freight space.         Demonstrated experience with existing open-source NLR tools for freight and logistics terminal models, such as ALTRIOS or ALTRIOS-LIFTS.        .    Job Application Submission Window   The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. jobs.title: 2027 Staff Accountant Intern
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!  We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.     Dare to bring your unique perspective?   At Novogradac, we value individuals who bring unique perspectives and bold ideas. If you’re eager to contribute to an inclusive, innovative environment where your personal and professional growth is encouraged and supported, we invite you to explore this exciting opportunity with us. Novogradac is hiring Staff Accountant Interns to explore our firm for busy season 2027 ( January 2027   through the end of   March 2027  ).      Position Summary   This distinct internship program is designed to expose the future leaders of public accounting not only to our partners, but also to our business and how we empower our clients' businesses. Our trendsetting interns learn hands-on what it takes to be a staff accountant for a growing national CPA firm by tackling a variety of different assignments, including audit, tax preparation and research. Novogradac believes in giving our interns a real-life business experience and compensating you well while you’re here. Some positions at Novogradac may be open to remote or hybrid work arrangements depending on business needs.  Please discuss available options with your recruiter.     Your Contributions and Responsibilities     Complete tax and/or audit engagements for designated clients as directed by your Supervisor or Manager    Identify and communicate potential problem areas during engagements    Conduct business-specific research – gather and analyze data, interpret results, compile reports and make recommendations to principals and partners    Develop effective client relationships through professionalism and follow-through    Other duties and projects as assigned       Your Background and Skills     Working toward a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in accounting or finance (obtained degree is a plus), and/or appropriate balance of education and work experience    GPA of 3.20 or higher    Preferred completion of  at least one Intermediate Accounting   course and preferably on track or already qualified to sit for the CPA examination     Exhibit a basic understanding of accounting and tax rules    Excellent verbal and written communication skills    Perform work accurately and in a time-efficient manner with strong attention to detail, organization and follow-through    Ability to work under close supervision and accept constructive feedback, making adjustments as directed    Ability to work collaboratively and foster a productive, team-oriented environment with both colleagues and clients    Strong computer skills, including solid skill in the Microsoft Office suite (particularly Word & Excel) and report writing tools       Why work with us?   Novogradac is committed to fostering a welcoming workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to grow. We believe in offering a supportive, balanced work environment that encourages professional growth and work-life integration.     We are proud to offer     Competitive salaries with continuous review of market conditions    Flexible working hours and work arrangements    Remote and hybrid opportunities    Inclusive workplace, providing strong professional growth and development opportunities       The benefits of joining our team     Strong growth opportunities    Strong emphasis on quality work-life integration    Dress for your day policy    Resources of a national firm    Opportunities to engage with our active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), affinity groups, and advance your career within a supportive, inclusive environment    Compensation: $27/hr       Don’t Meet Every Single Qualification?   After reviewing this job posting, are you hesitating to apply because you don’t meet all the listed requirements? At Novogradac, we are dedicated to building a workplace supported by unique perspectives and experiences, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.    You may still be the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.     Get to know us better!   We’re Novogradac, a national certified public accounting and consulting firm headquartered in San Francisco. Founded in 1989, the allied group of Novogradac companies has grown to more than 900 employees and partners with more than 25 offices throughout the country.    Novogradac is one of the nation’s top 40 certified public accounting and consulting firms and is a recognized leader in real estate and community development. Novogradac provides publicly and privately held national enterprises with a full spectrum of audit, tax, valuation, expert witness and litigation support, property compliance and general consulting services and works extensively in the affordable housing, community development, historic preservation and renewable energy fields. jobs.description: About the Opportunity      Job Summary      The Director of Campus Operations provides leadership, coordination, and direction across a broad portfolio of operational functions that support the university’s mission and daily campus life. Reporting to the Dean of the Oakland Campus, this role ensures the effective planning, execution, and continuous improvement of campus operations, infrastructure and initiatives. Serves as a strategic partner and operational leader, aligning resources, systems, and processes to promote efficiency, sustainability, and service excellence. Working collaboratively with institutional partners, the Senior Director of Campus Operations & Strategy leads efforts to improve the quality and efficiency of campus facilities and services, ensuring that both the physical environment and service delivery reflect the university’s mission and priorities.     Minimum Qualification    The Director of Campus Operations, Oakland is expected to have strategic, operational, and interpersonal skills, along with broad and deep expertise in the requisite areas of responsibility. The role requires a professional who brings confidence and humility to leading a service organization, with strong communication and relationship skills and a commitment to transparency. Effective decision-making, strategic planning, and project management expertise are essential. The ideal candidate is a diplomatic, service-oriented leader with the ability to collaborate with staff, administrators, faculty, and outside constituents.  Experience with change management and facilities operations management.  Ability to read and interpret architectural blueprints, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP) drawings, and site plans to support campus operations and capital projects is a plus.  Knowledge and skills required are typically acquired through completion of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent, plus at least 8 to10 years of experience that includes leading and delivering complex large-scale projects and partnerships, often managing a range of internal and external stakeholders as well as significant interaction with senior leadership teams. An advanced degree or professional credential is desirable as is experience in higher education.        Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities      Strategic Leadership & Planning      Partner with institutional and departmental leaders to align facilities operations and campus life with university priorities and long-term campus strategies.  Support specific Dean’s Office initiatives designed to integrate campus infrastructure with student, staff and faculty experiences.  Lead initiatives that improve the quality, efficiency, and experience of campus operations, facilities, and services.  Provide data-informed recommendations that support decision-making, resource allocation, and operational excellence.  Develop and monitor key performance metrics that measure effectiveness, service quality, and customer satisfaction.      Operational Coordination & Delivery    Oversee cross-functional coordination of daily campus operations, ensuring that building services, maintenance, and infrastructure systems run smoothly and responsively.  Identify and implement process improvements to enhance service delivery, reduce costs, and minimize disruptions of campus activities.  Ensure compliance with university standards, safety regulations, and sustainability commitments.  Support emergency preparedness, business continuity, and operational resilience planning.      Partnership & Communication    Build strong relationships with Facilities, Campus Planning, Sustainability, Residential Life, Provost Office, and other university stakeholders to promote collaboration and shared accountability.  Communicate operational priorities, performance outcomes, and strategic updates to senior leadership.  Champion a culture of service, accountability, and continuous improvement across campus operations teams. Promote equity, inclusion, and engagement in all aspects of team and departmental operations.  Lead efforts to strengthen internal communication and knowledge sharing within facilities and campus operations. jobs.title: Operations Planning Intern
jobs.description: Ocean Spray Cranberries, Inc. is a leading multi-national consumer packaged goods company (CPG), specializing in the sales of Cranberry products. Formed as a Grower-Owned Cooperative in 1930, Ocean Spray® is owned by a diverse network of over 700 Cranberry Farmers. These growers, many of which are multi-generational farming families who have been a part of the Cooperative for decades, are the foundation for all that we do.  Ever aware of our long-term commitment to our Growers, we care deeply about sustainability— in regard to both our business metrics and the environment—and believe that a focus on strong environmental management is an integral part of the way we manage our business.          At Ocean Spray, our purpose is to generate a passion for our Farmer’s fruit around the world by connecting our farms to families for a better life. Living out our values of Grower Mindset, Sustainable Results, Integrity Above All, Inclusive Teamwork (GRIT) has made Ocean Spray® a creative, entrepreneurial, energetic, and fun place to work.        Position Description:           The Global Supply Chain intern will work in a cross-functional capacity across the supply planning organization  .    This role will provide exposure to supply planning, material planning, as well as supply chain analytics  .    The role will be a mix of tactical responsibility planning supply, securing   materials   as well as a key project for the organization  .    As the Global Supply Chain intern, you will be exposed to multiple aspects of the global supply chain organization, not exclusively limited to the following:             Supply Planning               Material Planning               Supply Chain Analytics               Network Optimization                    Minimum Knowledge,   Skills   and Ability requirements:             Must be a current student enrolled in   Supply Chain, Operations, or Business Relevant related degree program               Classroom or academic exposure to supply chain fundamentals with overall good academic standing at the respective university               Desire and willingness to pursue a career in supply chain or operations as an early career professional               Highly organized, self-motivated with the ability to work independently                 Hourly Pay   Range:           $2  3  .00 - $  30.00             Duration & Location:             Position will start June 8, 2027, and run for 10-  12 weeks  .               Traditional work week but with summer Fridays 8:00am-12:30pm               Interns will have the opportunity to   participate   in multiple events throughout the summer including leadership panels, a day of fun in   Boston   and learning sessions from various business functions.               This position will be   located   at our corporate headquarters in Lakeville, MA (about 45 minutes South of Boston – Exit 6   off   Rte  .   495).              Who We Are:      You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. But did you know that the hardworking people growing the superfruit in our products are 700 family farmers that own our cooperative? They entrust us with what is most precious to them to create new and innovative products that will delight consumers and grow this beloved brand today and into the future. Sustainable      R     esults    – Guided by purpose, we are focused on delivering results for our grower-owners.      I     ntegrity Above All    – We are ethical, doing the right thing for our grower-owners, customers, consumers and each other     Inclusive      T     eamwork    – We build diverse and inclusive teams that strengthen our cooperative. jobs.description: FOR SUMMER 2027 CONSIDERATION      ABOUT US   | PFM was founded in 1975 to provide governments and public agencies with independent advice from professionals who understand their distinct financial needs and challenges. Our internship experience is designed to provide meaningful exposure to public finance, hands-on analytical work, and the collaborative culture that defines our firm. Many of our senior leaders began their careers as Interns, and we view this role as a vital entry point for future talent. jobs.title: Patient Financial Services Intern
jobs.description: Intern, Supply Chain       Join Our Life-Saving Team!      Are you ready to elevate your career to new heights? PHI Health is looking for dynamic, driven individuals to join our team. We are committed to providing top-tier emergency medical services with unmatched speed and efficiency, saving lives when every second counts. By supporting our mission from the ground, you will play a crucial role in orchestrating the seamless operations that keep our advanced fleet soaring and our patients safe.    With PHI Health you’ll collaborate with the best minds in the industry, driving initiatives that enhance our services and expand our reach to those who need it most. If you're passionate about making a difference and thrive on challenges, PHI Health offers an extraordinary opportunity to impact lives and develop your professional career in a meaningful way.       Who We Are:     PHI Health is the leading air ambulance provider in the United States. With an unmatched safety record and the best aviation, medical and communication specialists in the field, we set the standard in the air medical industry. We transport more than 22,000 patients each year from our more than 80 bases across the country, all while offering services and outreach education to local communities and leading healthcare systems. Our mission is simple: move communities to health while maintaining the highest standard of safety, period.      Position Overview:   Under the guidance and supervision of the Manager, Patient Financial Services, the Intern, PFS will receive training in the fundamental aspects of medical billing and collections. This role offers progressive learning opportunities, focusing on insurance payer requirements, patient advocacy principles, and the performance of demographic and payer research to support the revenue cycle process.     Job Summary:     Depending upon the PFS team assigned, the Intern will primarily complete the following tasks:   Basic working knowledge of HCPCS, CPT, ICD-9/ICD-10 codes and medical terminology  Demonstrate the ability to contact insurance and government agencies to obtain eligibility, to process authorizations or discuss benefits and billing requirements  Identify appropriate contacts and communicate in a professional manner with all facilities and first responders to obtain demographic information for billing  Prepare and submit clean insurance claims to payers electronically and by paper, as required  Monitor claim status and follow up on unpaid or rejected claims to ensure timely reimbursement  Follow up on outstanding insurance and patient account balances to ensure timely reimbursement  Communicate with insurance companies to resolve denied, delayed, or underpaid claims  Document all collection activity and payer correspondence within the billing system  Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service when interacting with patients and payers  Review medical documentation to assign accurate ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes for diagnoses, procedures, and services  Maintain up-to-date knowledge of coding changes, payer requirements, billing guidelines and industry compliance regulations  Protect patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations in all billing, collection and coding activities  Complying with Company HS&E policy and procedures  Responsible for supporting company Safety Management Systems activities  Understand and provide visible support of Destination Zero  Other duties and responsibilities as assigned      Schedule/Location:     5 & 2    Phoenix, AZ       The Successful Candidate Will Have:    High school diploma or equivalent required  Must be participating in an education-related internship with a certified program.  Must have knowledge of general office procedures using office equipment  Must have general PC skills and some knowledge of Microsoft Office including Word and Excel  Must have prior experience with email and using the web  This position is designated Safety Sensitive for purposes of the Arizona Medical Marijuana Act.      Organizational Competencies:      Safe . We are absolute in our belief in the tenets of Destination Zero and that Zero is not only achievable, but the only acceptable outcome.     Efficient . We are focused on outcomes that are smart and responsible by making the best use of our resources to maximize overall productivity and achieve sustainable profitability as a high performing organization.     Quality . We are committed to ensuring excellent organizational performance which produces sustainable and reliable outcomes.      Service . We are dedicated to the service of our customers, our communities and each other.       Behavioral Competencies:      Show Real Grit -  With safety as your guide, you pursue every task with drive, energy and a commitment to finish. You give all that the situation requires, even in the face of resistance or setbacks. You serve with resiliency, determined to help others.   Perform with Integrity –  You always do what’s right.   Be a great team player -  In order to achieve the best possible outcomes for our patients and customers, you must treat others with dignity and respect, and be committed to working as a cohesive team toward a common purpose.   Give and Get Help -  Giving your all in the service of others can tax your wellbeing. Know the signs and have the courage to give help and get help when needed.        The PHI Health Advantage:     For more than 40 years, our company has been providing critical air medical transport services across the country. As an organization, we outfit each aircraft we fly with the most advanced technology, subject our crews to the most rigorous protocols and training and pioneer the most-forward thinking safety program in the country.    Everything that we do comes back to the safety of our crew and our patients. Our accident rate is well below the national average, and we were the first to receive the Vision Zero Aviation Safety Award. T

jobs.title: 2027 PGM Golf Operations Intern
jobs.description: TPC River Highlands is a private golf club located in Cromwell, Connecticut, just outside of Hartford. As the proud host of the PGA TOUR’s Travelers Championship—the state’s largest professional sporting event—it stands as one of the premier destinations in the TPC Network. Alongside its championship golf course, the clubhouse offers an exceptional setting for events of all kinds, with scenic views, multiple event spaces, and two full-service kitchens. Known for its welcoming, team-oriented culture, TPC River Highlands delivers an outstanding experience for members, guests, and staff alike.                                                                                   Tee up your career as a part of our team with the TPC Network!                                                                                  Launch your career in professional golf with the TPC Network. Our Golf Operations Internship provides future PGA Professionals with hands-on experience in golf operations, member and guest service, and professional golf tournament management at a premier golf facility.     Interns work alongside experienced Golf Professionals and gain practical, supervised experience that supports progress toward PGA of America Membership while developing the skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in golf.    Two internship opportunities are available:    Inside Golf Operations  – Gain experience in golf shop operations, member and guest service, merchandising, tee time management, tournaments, and day-to-day golf administration.   Outside Golf Operations  – Develop experience in player services, golf car and bag operations, practice facility management, course setup, and creating an exceptional arrival-to-departure experience for members and guests.   Intern responsibilities and opportunities will vary based on the intern's experience and progress within their Professional Golf Management (PGM) program and/or PGA of America program. All levels emphasize TPC's commitment to service excellence, professional development, and the TPC Vision, Mission, and Values.   Pay beginning at minimum wage.      What You'll Gain    Hands-on experience in a professional golf operation  Practical experience supporting PGA TOUR-level tournament operations  Supervised work experience toward PGA of America Membership  Exposure to both member-focused club operations and professional tournament management  Mentorship and professional development from experienced Golf Professionals  Experience that can prepare you for future opportunities within the TPC Network    We're Looking For   Students currently enrolled in a Professional Golf Management (PGM) program or pursuing a career as a PGA Professional who are eager to learn, contribute, and develop their skills in a premier golf environment. To learn more about the TPC Golf Operations Internship Program, visit http://tpc.com/about-internship

Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills  Experience with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Power BI, or project-management coursework would be preferred but not required          About Us    At Polar Semiconductor, we’re on a mission to fulfill our future as the U.S. based manufacturing partner of choice for differentiated power and sensor technologies. With a $525M investment from the CHIPs Act, the state of Minnesota, and private equity, we are looking for the best in the industry to help Polar transform from a captive fab to a pure-play foundry.  We are doubling our manufacturing capacity and investing in advanced BCD and Wide Bandgap technology such as GaN.  Polar has a long history in manufacturing automotive grade semiconductors and we are expanding in strategic markets such as national defense and AI data centers.  We pride ourselves on state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing, a collaborative culture, and a commitment to helping our customers succeed.       What We Offer:     Salary : $25.50 - $32.20 per hour. Pay offered is based on many factors including, but not limited to, the job-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate.       Benefits & Other Eligible Compensation : Includes 401(k) plan and paid time off.   Polar Semiconductor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. From mentorship and networking opportunities to executive speaker sessions, a team case competition, and our signature Intern Summit, you'll build valuable skills, expand your network, and gain exposure to potential career opportunities. Along the way, you'll collaborate with experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful work, and grow both personally and professionally.    💦  About Pentair    At Pentair, we believe the health of our world depends on reliable access to clean water.  We design, manufacture, and deliver a comprehensive range of smart, sustainable water solutions to homes, business, and industries around the world.  Whether it is improving, moving, or enjoying water, we help manage the world’s most precious resource.     👍    Pentair Will:      Offer meaningful, hands-on work through a strategic business project that will allow you to make a real impact while developing valuable professional skills. Provide the opportunity to showcase your accomplishments through a final presentation to Pentair leaders, with the potential to be considered for future full-time opportunities upon graduation.      📃  Minimum Qualifications:    Be pursuing a bachelor’s degree in business (Sales, Finance, Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Supply Chain, Management) or related field from an accredited university   Be enrolled as a junior undergraduate (Preferred Graduation Date: Spring 2028)  Have a strong interest in pursuing Pentair’s full-time Sales Leadership Development Program upon graduation  Willing to relocate and work in locations throughout the United States while in Pentair's Leadership Development Program  Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint   Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future     ✅  Key Information:     12-week internship  program with two start date options:  Session 1: Late May – Early August 2027  Session 2: Early June – Mid-August 2027    This position pays an hourly rate of  $28.00/ hour . jobs.description: Job Description:          Ignite your Career Journey with Pentair’s Leadership Development Internship Program!     Are you ready to gain hands-on experience, develop your leadership skills, and make a meaningful impact? Pentair is seeking ambitious, innovative, and driven students to join our Leadership Development Internship Program.    🚀  What Awaits You   Embark on a 12-week experience where you'll contribute to meaningful work, build lasting connections, and grow both personally and professionally. Through hands-on projects, mentorship, networking opportunities, and intern-focused programming, you'll gain valuable experience and develop skills that will help prepare you for the next step in your career.    🌎  Make a Difference   Each intern will be assigned to a real-world, strategic business project that you will be immersed in for the summer. Your work will directly help Pentair achieve our mission of a more sustainable future. Interns will present their project objectives, processes, and overall results and impact to leadership at the internship program's end.    🌐  Professional Cohort Development   As a Pentair intern, you'll join a cohort of talented students from across the organization and participate in meaningful development experiences throughout the summer. From mentorship and networking opportunities to executive speaker sessions, a team case competition, and our signature Intern Summit, you'll build valuable skills, expand your network, and gain exposure to potential career opportunities. Along the way, you'll collaborate with experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful work, and grow both personally and professionally.    💦  About Pentair    At Pentair, we believe the health of our world depends on reliable access to clean water.  We design, manufacture, and deliver a comprehensive range of smart, sustainable water solutions to homes, business, and industries around the world.  Whether it is improving, moving, or enjoying water, we help manage the world’s most precious resource.     👍    Pentair Will:      Offer meaningful, hands-on work through a strategic business project that will allow you to make a real impact while developing valuable professional skills.    Provide on-the-job training, mentorship, and coaching from experienced professionals invested in your growth and success.    Pay competitively.    Provide opportunities to connect with leaders across the organization through executive speaker sessions, coffee chats, networking events, and mentorship experiences.    Offer a variety of professional development, social, volunteer, and cohort experiences designed to help you build your network and accelerate your growth.    Give you the opportunity to collaborate with fellow interns through a team case competition and attend Pentair's Intern Summit, bringing together interns from across the company for learning, development, and connection.    Provide the opportunity to showcase your accomplishments through a final presentation to Pentair leaders, with the potential to be considered for future full-time opportunities upon graduation.       📃   Minimum Qualifications:    Be currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Management of Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or Computer Science from an accredited university  Be currently enrolled as a junior undergraduate (Preferred Graduation Date: Spring 2028)   Be willing to work during the summer in our Golden Valley, MN location  Have a strong interest in pursuing Pentair’s full-time IT & Cybersecurity Leadership Development Program upon graduation  Willing to relocate and work in locations throughout the United States while in Pentair's Leadership Development Program  Have strong technical aptitude in at least one IT domain (application development, infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.)  Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint    Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future      ✅  Key Information:     12-week internship  program with two start date options:  Session 1: Late May – Early August 2027  Session 2: Early June – Mid-August 2027    This position pays an hourly rate of  $31.00/ hour . Interns work approximately 40-hours each week during the internship.  Financial support may be offered to those relocating for Pentair’s Summer 2027 Internship Program.      Posting End Date:  March 1st, 2027   Equal Opportunity Employer     Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

jobs.description: ABOUT US       PHINIA:  Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow.      PHINIA is a diversified industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY®, and HARTRIDGE™. With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 12,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 20 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.     Read More          JOB PURPOSE      PHINIA is seeking a currently enrolled student who has completed at least their freshman year and is pursuing a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.   This internship provides an opportunity to develop foundational knowledge of financial consolidation and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, including OneStream and SAP. The selected candidate will participate in focused projects, support data analytics initiatives, and gain exposure to financial systems and processes used in a global organization.   This role is designed to help bridge the gap between academic coursework and industry financial systems by providing hands-on training with leading technologies that are often not extensively covered in university programs. Interns will gain practical experience with financial information systems, data management, and business processes while building skills that are highly valued in finance and technology-focused careers.    *Note: This is a hybrid position, and candidates will be expected to be in office at least 3 days per week per discussion with Hiring Manager.      KEY RESPONSIBILITIES         Assist with troubleshooting issues related to Accounting and Information Systems (IS)        On-going development of an understanding of the relationship between Accounting, Finance, and IT systems        Learning and utilization basic functions and tools within OneStream, SAP, and other financial systems        Support system monitoring, maintenance, and documentation activities        Assist with data management, security roles, and user access administration        Gaining familiarity with organizational structures and business processes across IT, Accounting, and Finance teams        Job Requirements       Ability to work a year-long internship; Part-time schedule (approximately 20 hours per week) during the academic year, with potential for full-time (40 hours per week) work during the summer    Minimum GPA of 2.5 required       Sophomore standing or higher       Currently pursuing a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Economics, or Management Information Systems       Concentration on coursework in Accounting, Information Technology, or Management Information Systems preferred       Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a hybrid work environment       Familiarity with OneStream and SAP is preferred but not required; training will be provided       Self-motivated individual seeking professional growth and hands-on experience       Opportunity to work with cross-functional teams, including IT, Accounting, Internal Audit, and Finance       Strong written and verbal communication skills       Exposure to financial planning, reporting, analysis, and compliance processes        EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY      PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.      VISA SPONSORSHIP         For this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis in the country where the position is based. Only in certain circumstances, based on business need, does PHINIA provide sponsorship for employment visa status.      NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS      PHINIA does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or third-party vendors. Any recruitment partnership must be approved in writing by Human Resources before candidate submissions are made.      GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT      Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your  ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.  Please access the linked document by clicking  here  ,  select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review.   Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.      Career Scam Disclaimer:       PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website.  To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact PHINIA through PHINIA’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities. jobs.description:
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.     Count on us.  Our "we-care" culture is more than just a motto; it's a promise. From day one, we prioritize your growth, well-being, and success. You can count on us to support your career journey and help you achieve your professional goals. Join us.    Whether you intend to specialize or you’d rather gain exposure across many service lines, the sky’s the limit. From day one, we invite you to make a difference—to be remarkable.    Your role.    No busy work here. As an intern, you’ll be treated just like our entry level staff. You’ll help instill confidence in organizations large and small by assuring their financial health. We’ll give you the flexibility to craft business solutions, not just spreadsheets. Your work will include, but not be limited to:    Providing international tax consulting services for business arising from inbound and outbound cross-border activities.  Providing tax services for individuals working in US and foreign countries.  Preparing and reviewing global tax return compliance for US companies.  Opportunity to interact with tax engagement team as part of client entrenchment.  Researching developments within the international arena that may affect client businesses, both globally and locally.  Developing meaningful interactions with staff at all levels and across offices.  Deepen knowledge in both tax and tax consulting through exposure to both service lines.     The qualifications.     Detail-oriented leader with problem solving, communication, and analytical skills.  Pursuing a Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in accounting; or a Master's degree in accounting or tax, or LLM.  Completed the first two entry-level accounting courses and at a minimum, currently enrolled in the first intermediate level accounting course.  Academic success (a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0).  On track to complete the requisite degree and supporting credits to sit for the CPA exam, with the goal of successfully obtaining your CPA license.  This internship program is designed for students currently pursuing a degree and planning to return to school following the internship. Candidates who will complete their degree requirements before or during the internship are encouraged to apply for our entry-level opportunities.    This is a non-exempt position and may require work hours that exceed the standard 40-hour work week. This position may require some local, national, and occasional international travel.
